title: The GCTI™ Framework: Structured Analytic Techniques in Corporate Geopolitical Risk

detail.title: The GCTI™ Framework: Structured Analytic Techniques in Corporate Geopolitical Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This working paper was developed entirely by Jose Parejo & Associates (JPA) using proprietary methodology and internal research resources. The authors have no financial relationships with any of the institutions, firms, or publications referenced in this document.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was self-funded by Jose Parejo & Associates as part of its applied intelligence research programme.

detail.abstract: This technical white paper introduces the Global Corporate Threat Intelligence (GCTI™) framework, a proprietary applied intelligence methodology developed by Jose Parejo & Associates (JPA). The framework addresses a persistent structural gap in corporate risk advisory: the disconnect between macro-level geopolitical forecasting and the operationally precise intelligence required for boardroom decision-making. Drawing on field experience across more than 100 countries and five continents, the paper argues that the primary failure mode in corporate geopolitical risk is not analytical depth, but the absence of structured methods for translating intelligence into actionable governance outputs. The GCTI™ framework resolves this through the systematic deployment of Structured Analytic Techniques (SATs) — including Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH), Premortem Disruption Modeling, and High-Impact/Low-Probability Threat Assessments — originally developed within Western sovereign intelligence communities and codified in CIA and ODNI analytical standards. The paper situates the GCTI™ framework within the broader transatlantic risk advisory landscape alongside institutional counterparts including Eurasia Group, McLarty Associates, and the US Army War College Strategic Studies Institute, establishing a clear methodological position for boutique applied intelligence as a complementary and distinct capability. Outputs of the framework are designed to be legally defensible, auditable, and directly usable in international dispute resolution, asset protection, and multi-jurisdictional compliance. This document is registered for open-access indexing via SSRN and Zenodo and forms part of the permanent methodological corpus of Jose Parejo & Associates.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Jose Parejo & Associates开发的全球企业威胁情报（GCTI™）框架，旨在弥合宏观地缘政治预测与董事会决策所需操作级情报之间的结构性鸿沟，通过系统化运用结构化分析技术（SATs）将情报转化为可执行的治理输出。
AI.research_question: 如何弥合宏观地缘政治预测与企业董事会层面可操作情报之间的结构性断裂？
AI.motivation: 企业地缘政治风险管理的主要失败原因不在于分析深度不足，而在于缺乏将情报转化为可执行治理产出的结构化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: GCTI™框架、结构化分析技术（SATs）、竞争性假设分析（ACH）、前置情景颠覆建模、高影响/低概率威胁评估；参照CIA和ODNI分析标准。
AI.method: 基于在100多个国家和五大洲的实地经验，采用结构化分析技术（SATs）套件，包括ACH、前置情景颠覆建模和高影响/低概率威胁评估。
AI.findings: GCTI™框架能够产出法律上可辩护、可审计且可直接用于国际争端解决、资产保护和多法域合规的情报输出，弥补了传统地缘政治风险咨询在操作层面的不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将主权情报界的结构化分析技术（SATs）系统性地引入企业风险咨询领域，建立精品应用情报作为独立且互补能力的方法论定位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会提供可操作、可审计、法律上可辩护的地缘政治威胁情报输出，服务于国际争端解决、资产保护和跨国合规等实际场景。

title: From Traits to Troubles: Exploring CEO Personality and Adverse Financial Restatements
affiliations: , ,  and University of Georgia - Terry College of Business

detail.title: From Traits to Troubles: Exploring CEO Personality and Adverse Financial Restatements
detail.abstract: The personality of CEOs is increasingly garnering attention as it relates to the accounting discipline due to the documented impact on important firm level outcomes. In this work, we examine the role of CEOs Big Five Personality traits on the occurrence and severity of adverse financial restatements. Leveraging machine and deep learning techniques, we first extract CEO personality scores from the audio, visual, and text features of videos. These scores are then used to advance understanding surrounding the relationship between CEO personality and adverse financial restatements of firms, controlling for firm and CEO characteristics. Results reveal that CEO extraversion is the most robust indicator of adverse financial restatements, increasing the likelihood of their occurrence. When adverse financial restatements occur, CEO neuroticism and conscientiousness reduce their severity as proxied by negative market reactions. These results underscore how CEO personality may shape the financial reporting of firms.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用机器学习和深度学习技术，从CEO视频的音频、视觉和文本特征中提取大五人格得分，发现CEO外向性是负面财务重述最稳健的预测因子（增加发生概率），而神经质和尽责性在重述发生时能降低其严重程度（以负面市场反应衡量）。
AI.research_question: CEO的大五人格特质如何影响企业负面财务重述的发生概率和严重程度？
AI.motivation: CEO人格已受到会计学领域越来越多的关注，因其对重要企业层面结果有显著影响，但CEO人格对财务报告质量（尤其是财务重述）的影响尚缺乏深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大五人格理论（外向性、神经质、尽责性、宜人性、开放性）
AI.method: 利用机器学习和深度学习技术，从CEO视频的音频、视觉和文本特征中提取人格得分，然后进行回归分析，控制企业和CEO特征。
AI.findings: 1. CEO外向性是负面财务重述最稳健的预测因子，增加其发生概率；2. CEO神经质和尽责性在负面财务重述发生时降低其严重程度（以负面市场反应衡量）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将大五人格理论拓展到财务报告领域，揭示了CEO人格特质对财务重述发生与严重程度的差异化影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会、投资者和监管机构评估CEO人事决策和财务报告风险提供基于人格特质的新视角；展示了利用多模态视频数据进行人格测量的可行方法。

title: A Convex Reformulation of the Deribit Portfolio Margin Model: A Note

detail.title: A Convex Reformulation of the Deribit Portfolio Margin Model: A Note

declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract: We present a convex portfolio margin model for derivatives exchanges and show that convexity enables a unified treatment of three core risk problems: margin computation, liquidation, and auto-deleveraging (ADL). The margin requirement is a single convex function of portfolio positions: the worst-case loss ρ max over a grid of spot and implied-volatility scenarios, augmented by a roll-risk adjustment via full repricing and a linear surcharge for concentrated positions. Convexity reduces minimum-cost liquidation and fair ADL to tractable convex programmes with global-optimality guarantees. We contrast this with the portfolio margin model of Deribit, the leading crypto options exchange, and identify two structural issues: additive delta-and roll-risk overlays driven by a signmasked offset that is non-convex in positions, and a roll-risk approximation that is first-order in delta and misses gamma-driven exposure near expiry. The convex framework eliminates both while remaining simple to implement and audit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于衍生品交易所的凸投资组合保证金模型，通过单一凸函数统一处理保证金计算、清算和自动去杠杆化三大核心风险问题，并与Deribit现有模型对比，指出了其非凸性和近似不足等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个凸性的投资组合保证金模型，使其能够统一且最优地处理保证金计算、清算和自动去杠杆化三个核心风险问题？
AI.motivation: 现有衍生品交易所的保证金模型（如Deribit）存在非凸性结构问题，导致清算和ADL过程无法保证全局最优，且对尾部风险（如gamma风险）的近似不够准确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凸优化理论；投资组合风险模型；最坏情况损失（worst-case loss）框架
AI.method: 构建一个单一凸函数作为保证金要求：基于现货和隐含波动率场景网格的最坏情况损失ρ_max，加上通过完整重新定价实现的滚动风险调整，以及针对集中头寸的线性附加费。利用凸性将最小成本清算和公平ADL转化为可处理的凸规划问题。
AI.findings: 凸框架能够消除Deribit模型中两个结构性问题：一是由符号掩码偏移导致的对冲叠加非凸性，二是仅考虑一阶delta而遗漏临近到期gamma风险的滚动风险近似；同时凸框架保持简单易实现和可审计。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将凸优化理论系统性地引入衍生品交易所的保证金模型设计，证明凸性可统一处理保证金、清算和ADL三个核心问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币期权交易所（如Deribit）提供了可直接改进的凸保证金模型，降低了清算和ADL的计算复杂度（可全局最优求解），同时提高了对尾部风险的覆盖精度。

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, KIEP Opinions No. 342
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The Trump Administration’s tariff strategy has entered a time-sensitive phase. After the Supreme Court ruling limited the use of emergency economic powers as a basis for broad tariff measures, the Administration turned to other statutory authorities to preserve tariff leverage. The most immediate instrument was a temporary global surcharge under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974. Section 122, however, permits an import surcharge of up to 15 percent for a period not exceeding 150 days unless extended by Congress. July 24, 2026, thus serves as an important statutory reference point for assessing how the Administration may seek to maintain tariff leverage after the temporary surcharge expires.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了特朗普政府关税战略的时间敏感阶段，重点探讨在最高法院限制紧急经济权力后，政府如何转向《1974年贸易法》第122条实施临时全球附加费，并指出2026年7月24日是一个关键的法定参考点。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府在临时关税附加费到期后，如何维持关税杠杆？
AI.motivation: 最高法院裁定限制了使用紧急经济权力作为广泛关税措施的依据，迫使特朗普政府寻找其他法定授权以维持关税施压能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易法框架、行政权力与法定授权理论、关税政策的时间政治学。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、政策时间线梳理、法定条款解释。
AI.findings: 《1974年贸易法》第122条允许最高15%的进口附加费，期限不超过150天（除非国会延长）；2026年7月24日是一个关键的法定截止日期，届时政府需寻求替代方案以维持关税杠杆。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行政分支在贸易政策中运用法定授权的时间约束机制，补充了关于总统贸易权力边界的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了关税政策时间窗口的关键预判，有助于评估贸易合规风险与供应链调整的紧迫性。

title: Comparative Analysis of Initial and Long-term Financial Commitments of Cloud-based and Onpremises Infrastructure Solutions for Large Language Models

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Initial and Long-term Financial Commitments of Cloud-based and Onpremises Infrastructure Solutions for Large Language Models
detail.abstract: The rapid advancements in artificial intelligence and deep learning, particularly in Large Language Models (LLMs), have significantly increased computational demands for organizations. This paper provides a comparative analysis of the initial and long-term financial commitments associated with cloud-based and on-premises infrastructure solutions for deploying LLMs across organizations of varying sizes. It examines the costefficiency, environmental impact, and required skill sets for managing these infrastructures. The study employs a mixed-methods approach, including a comprehensive literature review and a workshop involving students from a master's program in Business Information Systems. Key findings indicate that cloud-based solutions offer lower upfront costs and scalability, making them suitable for startups and small to medium-sized enterprises, while on-premises solutions provide greater control and potentially lower long-term costs, beneficial for larger organizations with specific compliance and data security needs. Additionally, the study highlights cost-reduction strategies such as transfer learning, sparse training, and optimal hyperparameter tuning. The results aim to guide organizations in aligning their infrastructure strategies with technical needs, financial constraints, and environmental responsibilities, thereby future proofing their investments in LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了云端与本地部署两种方案在大型语言模型（LLM）部署中的初始和长期财务投入，分析了成本效率、环境影响及所需技能集，旨在为不同规模的组织提供基础设施策略指导。
AI.research_question: 不同规模的组织在部署LLM时，云基础设施与本地基础设施在初始和长期财务投入、成本效率、环境影响及所需技能集方面存在怎样的差异？
AI.motivation: 人工智能和深度学习（尤其是LLM）的快速发展显著增加了组织的计算需求，但缺乏关于云端与本地部署方案的全面比较来指导组织的投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析、规模经济理论、IT基础设施管理理论
AI.method: 混合方法：系统文献综述 + 商务信息系统硕士生工作坊
AI.findings: 云端方案初始成本低、可扩展性强，适合初创企业和中小企业；本地方案控制力强、长期成本可能更低，适合有特定合规和数据安全需求的大型组织。研究还提出了迁移学习、稀疏训练、超参数调优等成本降低策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统比较了云端与本地部署LLM的成本结构，为IT基础设施投资决策提供了理论框架，并补充了LLM部署成本优化的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同规模组织提供了LLM基础设施选型指南，帮助其在技术需求、财务约束和环境责任之间取得平衡，并提出了具体的成本优化策略以提升投资的前瞻性。

reference: NYU Stern School of Business Research Paper; Forthcoming at Journal of Futures Markets; DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/fut.70126
title: CCP Competition, Margins, and Crowding in U.S. Treasury Market
affiliations: Stevens Institute of Technology - School of Business

detail.title: CCP Competition, Margins, and Crowding in U.S. Treasury Market

contentType.other: Forthcoming at Journal of Futures Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: NYU Stern School of Business Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: New York University Stern School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper presents a dynamic equilibrium model of U.S. Treasury clearing that endogenizes explicit, VaR-based initial margins, EWMA volatility updates, variation-margin feedback, cross-margining, and crowding effects within CCP competition. We cast clearing as a threestage stochastic game: CCPs commit to fees, margin multipliers, cross-margin discounts, and volatility-decay parameters; members allocate DV01 exposures in each period subject to funding-cost feedback from margin calls; and CCPs incur tail-risk, covariance, concentration, and infrastructure penalties over time. In the symmetric competitive equilibrium, stronger cross-margining discounts, dynamically calibrated skin-in-the-game buffers, concentration surcharges, and conservative margin-and-volatility regimes all reduce the joint default probability. We benchmark against a single-CCP monopoly and demonstrate that only under extreme crowding does a well-capitalized monopoly dominate. Our comparativestatics yield a comprehensive policy toolkit-transparent margin formulas, volatility-decay standards, feedback-cap mechanisms, cross-margin interoperability, and real-time crowding metrics-to guide resilient Treasury clearing.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了美国国债清算的动态均衡模型，分析了CCP竞争下的保证金、波动率、交叉保证金和拥挤效应，发现强交叉保证金折扣、动态资本缓冲、集中度附加费及保守的保证金-波动率制度能降低联合违约概率，并提供了政策工具包。
AI.research_question: 在CCP（中央对手方）竞争环境下，如何通过内生化的保证金制度、波动率更新、交叉保证金和拥挤效应来降低美国国债清算的联合违约概率？
AI.motivation: 美国国债市场是全球最重要的金融市场之一，其清算体系的韧性至关重要。现有文献缺乏对CCP竞争环境下各清算机制（保证金、波动率、交叉保证金等）如何相互作用并影响系统性风险的系统性建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机博弈模型（三阶段）：阶段1 CCP承诺费用、保证金乘数、交叉保证金折扣和波动率衰减参数；阶段2 成员在每个时期分配DV01敞口，受保证金追缴的融资成本反馈影响；阶段3 CCP随时间承担尾部风险、协方差、集中度和基础设施惩罚。
AI.method: 动态均衡模型，内生化VaR初始保证金、EWMA波动率更新、变动保证金反馈、交叉保证金和CCP竞争中的拥挤效应，并对比对称竞争均衡与单一CCP垄断基准。
AI.findings: (1) 强交叉保证金折扣、动态校准的"风险共担"缓冲、集中度附加费和保守的保证金-波动率制度均能降低联合违约概率；(2) 仅在极端拥挤情况下，资本充足的垄断CCP才优于竞争性市场结构；(3) 比较静态分析提供了全面的政策工具包。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将交叉保证金、拥挤效应和CCP竞争纳入统一的动态均衡框架，揭示了各清算机制之间的相互作用及其对系统性风险的非线性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了透明的保证金公式、波动率衰减标准、反馈上限机制、交叉保证金互操作性以及实时拥挤度指标等政策工具，为美国国债清算体系韧性建设提供操作指南。

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 944/2026
title: Inside Information in Protracted Processes after the Listing Act: End of the Story?
affiliations: University of Genoa - Law Department and Centre for Law and Finance and

detail.title: Inside Information in Protracted Processes after the Listing Act: End of the Story?

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 944/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Listing Act marks a significant turning point in the European regulation of inside information by reshaping the treatment of protracted processes under MAR. Moving away from the original framework developed in Geltl v. Daimler, the new regime adopts a clearer two-step model that separates the prohibition of insider dealing from the issuer’s duty of disclosure. While leaving the insider trading ban untouched, for protracted processes the new regime postpones disclosure until the occurrence of the final event. This reform aims to reduce the regulatory burden for listed companies and to reduce disclosure of preliminary information.

Our paper shows, however, that the Listing Act does not fully eliminate legal uncertainty. Although the Commission Delegated Regulation provides a more detailed taxonomy of protracted processes and identifies numerous examples of “final events,” the dividing line separating protracted processes and one-off events is a matter of interpretation and can occasionally raise doubts on its consequences. Following ESMA’s technical advice, the Commission Delegated Regulation confines the concept of protracted processes to developments that depend, at least in part, on the issuer’s own actions or decisions. This criterion leaves some questions concerning the boundaries of the new rules unresolved. One first question relates to the rationale for subjecting disclosure of external developments that evolve progressively over time to the old regime. A second question revolves around the treatment of inside information within corporate groups, including whether events occurring in controlled entities shall be treated as protracted processes or one-off events from the perspective of listed companies. A third question concerns disclosure relating to accounting data revealing profit warnings and earnings surprises.

Overall, the new regime will likely have a positive impact in that it increases certainty concerning the timing of disclosure for protracted processes, including periodic financial reports. However, substantial interpretive discretion remains regarding the treatment of external events, the organisation of internal information systems, and the identification of the corporate actors whose knowledge is attributable to the issuer. The actual impact of the new rules on these matters will, therefore, crucially depend on the interpretation by issuers, supervisors, and ultimately courts.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《上市法案》对欧盟内幕信息制度的改革，指出虽然该法案在处理"持续过程"（protracted processes）时采用了更清晰的两步模型、推迟了披露时点，但并未完全消除法律不确定性，特别是在外部事件、公司集团内部信息传递及会计数据披露等方面仍存在解释空间。
AI.research_question: 《上市法案》改革是否有效消除了欧盟内幕信息制度中关于"持续过程"的法律不确定性？
AI.motivation: 《上市法案》从根本上重塑了欧盟《市场滥用条例》（MAR）下对"持续过程"的处理方式，偏离了Geltl v. Daimler案确立的原有框架，旨在减轻上市公司监管负担并减少初步信息的披露。但这一改革是否真正实现了法律确定性，值得深入检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内幕信息制度中的"持续过程"理论、内幕交易禁止与披露义务的分离模型、法律确定性与监管裁量权的关系。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，对《上市法案》、欧盟委员会授权法规、ESMA技术建议等法律文本进行条文解释与逻辑推演。
AI.findings: （1）《上市法案》采用了两步模型，将内幕交易禁令与发行人的披露义务分离，对"持续过程"推迟至最终事件发生时披露；（2）但法律不确定性并未完全消除：持续过程与一次性事件的界限模糊、外部渐进事件的旧制度适用缺乏充分理由、公司集团内信息处理规则不明确、会计数据（盈利预警和盈余意外）的披露时机仍存疑；（3）新制度的效果很大程度上取决于发行人、监管机构和法院的后续解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了《上市法案》改革在法律确定性方面的结构性局限，指出现行区分标准（是否依赖发行人自身行为）导致的三个未被充分解决的边界问题，丰富了内幕信息制度中"持续过程"理论的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为上市公司、监管机构及法律从业者识别新制度下仍存在的合规风险点（外部事件处理、集团内部信息流、会计信息披露等）提供了明确指引，有助于实务操作中的风险预判。

title: Commercial Short Video Adoption: Examining interrelationship between Antecedents, Mediators and Consequences

detail.title: Commercial Short Video Adoption: Examining interrelationship between Antecedents, Mediators and Consequences
detail.abstract:
Short videos have become really popular in past few years and have emerged as a revolutionary tool in digital marketing, influencer marketing, brand awareness and purchase decisions. This study investigates the key factors driving Commercial Short Video Adoption (CSVA) and focuses on the impact of Entertainment Value (EV), Information Seeking (IS), Ease of Access (EA) and Social Interaction (SI) with User Engagement (UE) as a mediating factor. Also, Age and Gender were examined as moderating variables to assess the effect of demographics in short video consumption.
In this study, a quantitative approach was used where an online survey was exercised to collect responses from 212 participants. The data was analysed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) in SmartPLS, reliability testing, normality testing, correlation analysis and multiple regression models in SPSS. The results revealed that IS, EA and SI have positive impact on UE which also have a strong relation with CSVA. However, EV does not have a significant effect on UE therefore it alone cannot be suggested as the primary motivator for consumption of commercial short videos.
Furthermore, the study confirms that CSVA has positive influence on both Purchase Intention (PI) and Brand Awareness (BA) which gives a favourable view of the effectiveness of short video marketing. Also, Gender influences the effect of EA on CSVA with women being more affected, while Age moderates the effect of SI on CSVA with older users engaging more through social interaction.
These findings provide valuable insights which can be used by marketers, businesses and brands looking to use short videos as a part of their marketing strategies. It also implies that businesses should prioritize informative and interactive content, ensure ease of access and leverage social engagement tools to maximize consumer adoption and conversion of potential customers. The study also contributes to marketing literature and Uses and Gratifications Theory (UGT) in the context of commercial short video adoption.
Despite its contributions, the study also has certain limitations. Future research should explore longitudinal studies for extended periods, cross platform comparisons and AI-driven personalization in short video engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨短视频营销中影响用户采纳商业短视频的关键因素，发现信息寻求、易用性和社交互动通过用户参与正向影响采纳行为，而娱乐价值作用不显著；性别和年龄具有调节效应，且商业短视频采纳正向影响购买意愿和品牌知名度。
AI.research_question: 哪些关键因素驱动商业短视频采纳（CSVA），以及用户参与（UE）的中介作用、年龄和性别的调节作用如何？
AI.motivation: 短视频已成为数字营销和品牌推广的重要工具，但驱动用户采纳商业短视频的关键因素尚不明确，尤其是娱乐价值、信息寻求、易用性和社交互动等因素的相对重要性缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用与满足理论（Uses and Gratifications Theory, UGT）
AI.method: 定量研究，通过在线问卷调查收集212份样本数据，采用SmartPLS进行结构方程模型（SEM）分析，并结合SPSS进行信度检验、正态性检验、相关分析和多元回归分析。
AI.findings: 信息寻求、易用性和社交互动正向影响用户参与，用户参与正向影响商业短视频采纳；娱乐价值对用户参与影响不显著；商业短视频采纳正向影响购买意愿和品牌知名度；性别调节易用性对采纳的影响（女性更强），年龄调节社交互动对采纳的影响（年长者更强）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将使用与满足理论（UGT）延伸到商业短视频采纳领域，验证了用户参与在影响因素与采纳之间的中介作用，并揭示了娱乐价值在商业情境下的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员和品牌提供策略建议：应优先制作信息性和互动性内容、确保易用性、善用社交互动工具；女性用户更关注易用性，年长用户更依赖社交互动，可据此进行差异化营销。

title: Analyst Forecast Biases and the Cost of Wishful Thinking
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor - Finance, INSEAD and INSEAD

detail.title: Analyst Forecast Biases and the Cost of Wishful Thinking
detail.abstract: We show that EPS forecasts exhibit underreaction and CAPEX forecasts exhibit overreaction, both at the individual and consensus levels, for the same analysts and firms. Standard models cannot reconcile this. We propose a wishful thinking model of forecasts in which analysts optimally distort beliefs about signal precision to gain anticipatory utility. A single parameter, the cost of belief distortion, generates both biases: high costs produce underreaction, low costs produce overreaction, and intermediate costs yield individual overreaction but consensus underreaction. The model further predicts that overreaction is stronger at longer horizons and among more experienced analysts, and that low-cost environments feature greater forecast dispersion and consensus volatility. We confirm these predictions in the data.

AI.tldr: 本文发现分析师对盈利预测反应不足，对资本支出预测反应过度，并提出"一厢情愿思维模型"：分析师通过扭曲信号精度信念来获取预期效用，单一参数（信念扭曲成本）即可同时解释两种偏差。
AI.research_question: 为什么同一分析师在同一公司上，对EPS预测表现为反应不足，而对CAPEX预测表现为反应过度？
AI.motivation: 标准模型无法同时解释分析师对不同财务指标预测的系统性偏差差异，需要新理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一厢情愿思维模型：分析师通过扭曲信号精度信念获得预期效用，信念扭曲成本高低决定预测偏差方向。
AI.method: 理论建模+实证检验（分析师个体层面与共识层面的预测数据）。
AI.findings: (1)高扭曲成本→反应不足，低扭曲成本→反应过度；(2)中等成本下个体过度反应但共识反应不足；(3)更长预测期和经验更丰富的分析师过度反应更强；(4)低成本环境预测分歧和共识波动更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出单一参数（信念扭曲成本）统一解释分析师预测的两种系统性偏差，拓展了行为金融中预期效用理论的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者理解分析师预测偏差的来源和规律，改进基于分析师预测的投资决策。

title: Epistemic Climate in Corporate Governance: A Two-Axis Diagnostic Framework for Board Decision Quality
affiliations: Straticom Technologies Sàrl

detail.title: Epistemic Climate in Corporate Governance: A Two-Axis Diagnostic Framework for Board Decision Quality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Straticom Technologies Sàrl and the developer of the instruments described in this paper. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: The governance diagnostic literature has developed substantially over three decades in its capacity to describe board dysfunction — the patterns of communication, composition, and process failure that characterise boards in difficulty. It has developed considerably less in its capacity to explain that dysfunction: to identify the causal conditions that produce governance failure before it becomes visible in outcomes. This paper introduces the Board Decision Climate Profile™ (BDC Profile™) and the Chair Epistemic Behaviour Instrument™ (CEBI™), two diagnostic instruments designed to measure the epistemic conditions under which boards make decisions. Drawing on peer-reviewed research in psychological safety (Edmondson, 1999, 2018), group cognition and hidden information (Forbes & Milliken, 1999; Stasser & Titus, 1985), cognitive diversity activation (Page, 2007; Reynolds & Lewis, 2017), and structured dissent (Janis, 1972; Sunstein & Hastie, 2015), we propose a two-axis governance climate model — Epistemic Safety and Cognitive Activation — whose intersection produces four Board Decision Climate States. The CEBI extends the framework by attributing climate state variation to the chair's specific epistemic behaviours across three dimensions: Invitation Behaviour, Safety Modelling, and Activation Practice. Together, the BDC Profile and CEBI constitute the second and third stages of the Complete Governance Climate Diagnostic™, a three-instrument sequence designed to move board assessment from pattern description to causal diagnosis. We document the theoretical foundations, construct architecture, instrument design, scoring logic, and a formal validation programme. Research limitations and future directions are identified.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了两套诊断工具（BDC Profile™和CEBI™），用于测量董事会决策的认知条件，将公司治理评估从描述模式提升到因果诊断层面。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和测量导致董事会治理失败（在结果显现之前）的认知条件？
AI.motivation: 现有治理诊断文献在描述董事会功能障碍方面有显著发展，但在解释功能障碍的因果机制方面进展不足，缺乏在问题显性化之前识别治理失败原因的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理安全（Edmondson）、群体认知与隐藏信息（Forbes & Milliken; Stasser & Titus）、认知多样性激活（Page; Reynolds & Lewis）、结构化异议（Janis; Sunstein & Hastie）等理论，构建了双轴治理气候模型——认知安全（Epistemic Safety）和认知激活（Cognitive Activation）。
AI.method: 开发了两套诊断工具：BDC Profile™（测量董事会的决策气候状态）和CEBI™（测量主席的认知行为），构成三阶段完整诊断体系的第二和第三阶段。
AI.findings: 双轴模型的交叉产生四种董事会决策气候状态；CEBI将气候状态差异归因于主席在邀请行为、安全示范和激活实践三个维度的认知行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将心理安全、认知多样性、结构化异议等认知心理学理论整合到公司治理诊断中，提出从描述到因果解释的治理评估理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会评估提供了可操作的诊断工具，使治理评估从事后描述（描述模式）转向事前因果诊断（识别认知条件），有助于在问题显性化前进行干预。

title: Digital Velocity with Institutional Discipline: A Framework for Structured Digital Transformation in Regulated Consumer Finance

detail.title: Digital Velocity with Institutional Discipline: A Framework for Structured Digital Transformation in Regulated Consumer Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on aggregated operational observations and institutional performance metrics presented in anonymized and non-identifiable form. No personal data, customer information, or human subject research was involved. Formal ethics committee approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a longitudinal practitioner case study of digital transformation executed across two regulated, high-volume sectors in Saudi Arabia: telecommunications (2012 to 2023) and consumer finance (2023 to present). Drawing on eleven years of direct operational and architectural leadership, the study examines how structural redesign, early eligibility gating, unified channel logic, and lifecycle governance converge to produce sustainable digital throughput in compliance-constrained environments. The central contribution is the Structured Velocity Operating Framework, a five-pillar conceptual model encompassing architectural decoupling, early eligibility gating, unified channel logic, operational intelligence, and lifecycle governance. Empirical evidence drawn from production deployments demonstrates measurable improvements across key performance dimensions: personal finance turnaround time reduced from approximately six to approximately two calendar days; application submission conversion increased from 71% to 95%; digital origination share reached approximately 95% of all business transactions; and post-redesign registrations grew approximately 3.8 times within a seven-month window. The paper argues that sustainable digital advantage in regulated financial institutions derives not from speed alone but from the institutional capacity to govern velocity across the full customer lifecycle. The findings are contextualized within Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 financial sector transformation agenda and the rapid expansion of the Kingdom's fintech ecosystem from 82 licensed entities in 2021 to over 280 by 2025. The Structured Velocity Framework is presented as a transferable operating model for regulated institutions seeking to reconcile transformation urgency with governance discipline.

AI.tldr: 本文基于沙特电信（2012-2023）和消费金融（2023至今）两个受监管高容量行业的纵向实践案例研究，提出了"结构化速度运营框架"（Structured Velocity Operating Framework），展示了在合规约束环境中通过架构解耦、早期资格筛选、统一渠道逻辑、运营智能和生命周期治理五大支柱实现可持续数字吞吐量的方法。
AI.research_question: 在受监管的高容量行业中，如何通过结构性设计和运营治理实现可持续的数字转型速度，同时满足合规要求？
AI.motivation: 受监管金融机构面临转型紧迫性与治理纪律之间的张力，单纯追求速度不可持续，需要系统化的运营框架来平衡速度与合规。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化速度运营框架（Structured Velocity Operating Framework），包含五大支柱：架构解耦（Architectural Decoupling）、早期资格筛选（Early Eligibility Gating）、统一渠道逻辑（Unified Channel Logic）、运营智能（Operational Intelligence）和生命周期治理（Lifecycle Governance）。
AI.method: 纵向实践案例研究，基于11年直接运营和架构领导经验，结合生产环境部署的实证数据。
AI.findings: 个人金融周转时间从约6天降至约2天；申请提交转化率从71%提升至95%；数字发起份额达到全部业务交易的约95%；重新设计后七个月内注册量增长约3.8倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"结构化速度"概念，论证了可持续数字优势来自跨越全客户生命周期的治理速度能力，而非单纯的速度本身。将速度与治理的张力转化为可操作的五支柱框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管机构提供了可转移的运营模型；展示了沙特Vision 2030背景下金融科技生态系统的快速发展路径（从2021年82家持牌实体到2025年超过280家）；为合规约束环境中的数字化转型提供了可量化的绩效改进证据。

title: Worker Turnover and the Returns to New Jobs in Türkiye: Insights from the 2005-2019 Household Labor Force Surveys
affiliations: Galatasaray University - Department of Economics and Galatasaray University

detail.title: Worker Turnover and the Returns to New Jobs in Türkiye: Insights from the 2005-2019 Household Labor Force Surveys

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Galatasaray University Scientific Research Projects Unit under project code FBA-2023-1132.

detail.abstract: In this study, we use the 2005-2019 TurkStat Household Labor Force Surveys to examine the changes in worker flows in Turkey and how different demographic groups are affected by these changes. We then estimate wage differentials between workers who started their current job within the last 12 months and those who have been employed in the same job for more than a year, taking tenure into account. Our descriptive analyses indicate that, due to the increase in worker turnover, labor market stratification has deepened, and a group of workers appears to be trapped in a cycle of temporary/low-quality jobs and unemployment. Regarding the impact of changes in worker flows on wages, our findings show that workers who changed jobs within the last 12 months earn lower wages compared to those who remained in their ongoing jobs. Moreover, our results suggest that when the returns to experience are high, job switching may become more costly.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2005-2019年土耳其家庭劳动力调查数据，分析了劳动力流动的变化及其对不同人口群体的影响，发现工人流动率上升导致劳动力市场分层加剧，部分工人陷入临时/低质量工作与失业的循环；同时，近期换工作者收入低于持续在职者，且经验回报越高时换工作成本越大。
AI.research_question: 土耳其劳动力流动如何变化？不同人口群体如何受这些变化影响？换工作与持续在职者之间的工资差异如何？
AI.motivation: 土耳其劳动力市场经历显著变化，工人流动率上升可能加剧市场分层和不平等，需系统研究流动模式变化及其对工资的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场分层理论、工作转换成本理论、经验回报理论
AI.method: 使用2005-2019年TurkStat家庭劳动力调查数据，进行描述性分析，并估计考虑任职期的工资差异模型。
AI.findings: 工人流动率上升加深了劳动力市场分层，部分工人陷入临时/低质量工作与失业的循环；近期换工作者工资低于持续在职者；经验回报越高时换工作成本越大。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了劳动力流动加剧市场分层的理论，揭示了经验回报与工作转换成本之间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其及其他新兴经济体劳动力市场政策制定提供实证依据，提示需关注低质量工作陷阱和工人流动成本问题。

title: Stress among the Employee: It is Leadership Style Matter?
affiliations: , Merlimau Polytechnic (Politeknik Merlimau) and Politeknik Kuching, Sarawak

detail.title: Stress among the Employee: It is Leadership Style Matter?
detail.abstract: Leadership plays an important role in keeping business remaining and competitive. Therefore, a good relationship between the leader and employees is very essential to ensure the objective organization is achieved. Stress among the employees shows no good signs because it may affect the organization's performance. The leadership style may influence employee stress. Democratic style or autocratic style have different perspectives on participating employees in the organization, which makes different stress among the employees. Democratic style allows the employee to participate in the decision-making process, which makes them happy. Less control and instruction from the leader. But autocratic style shows the leader prefers full control over the decision-making. The employee is either less or not participating in the decision-making process. This situation makes the employee stressed working under the autocratic style.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了领导风格（民主型与专制型）对员工压力的影响，指出民主型领导通过让员工参与决策降低压力，而专制型领导因集权控制增加员工压力，进而影响组织绩效。
AI.research_question: 领导风格（民主型 vs. 专制型）如何影响员工压力水平？
AI.motivation: 领导力对组织竞争力和绩效至关重要，而员工压力会损害组织绩效，因此需要探究不同领导风格如何通过员工参与程度影响压力水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导风格理论（民主型领导、专制型领导）；员工参与决策理论；工作压力理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和理论分析，未明确提及具体实证研究方法。
AI.findings: 民主型领导让员工参与决策，降低员工压力；专制型领导限制员工参与决策，增加员工压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将领导风格二分法（民主/专制）与员工压力机制联系起来，丰富了领导力与组织行为学的交叉理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供实践启示：采用民主型领导风格，赋予员工参与决策的权利，可有效降低员工压力，提升组织绩效。

title: Spatial Competition and Temporal Price Discrimination in Brazilian Street Markets
affiliations: Delta Economics & Finance

detail.title: Spatial Competition and Temporal Price Discrimination in Brazilian Street Markets
detail.abstract: I develop a unified equilibrium framework to explain the systematic pricing patterns observed in Brazilian street markets (feiras livres). Two contrasting market structures coexist within the same physical space: a perishable produce market, in which prices decline from dawn to noon and quality is positively associated with neighborhood income, and a market for the complementary treats pastel and caldo de cana, characterized by intraday price rigidity, spatial price dispersion, and lower prices on weekdays. For produce I construct a two-period adverse-selection model where sellers possess private quality information and face heterogeneous early-selling costs; rational-expectations equilibrium yields a declining price path and income-based quality sorting. For treats I first examine a Hotelling duopoly with an outside option, which explains income-sensitive price levels and the weekday-weekend differential but fails to deliver intra-market price dispersion. I then develop a Varian-type model with a nested loyalty structure of informed shoppers and uninformed locals, treating the two goods as perfect complements. This second treats model endogenously generates price dispersion across the poles of a market, sharpens the weekday-discount mechanism, and incorporates cross-market competitive pressure from cosmopolitan consumers. The two core models-adverse selection for produce and mixed-strategy spatial competition for treats-are complementary and jointly rationalize the full set of stylized facts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一均衡框架，解释巴西露天市场中两种共存市场结构（易腐农产品市场与互补品小吃市场）的系统性定价模式。
AI.research_question: 巴西露天市场中，易腐农产品与互补品小吃为何呈现出截然不同的定价模式？
AI.motivation: 在同一物理空间内，农产品价格随时间下降且质量与社区收入正相关，而小吃价格日内刚性、空间分散且工作日更低。现有理论难以同时解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期逆向选择模型（农产品）；Hotelling双寡头模型与Varian型混合策略空间竞争模型（小吃，含忠诚消费者结构）。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建理性预期均衡模型与混合策略纳什均衡模型，进行均衡分析与比较静态。
AI.findings: 农产品方面，逆向选择模型得出价格递减路径与收入基础的质量分层；小吃方面，Hotelling模型解释了收入敏感价格与工作日差异，Varian型模型内生生成市场内价格离散并纳入跨市场竞争压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将逆向选择与空间竞争两类机制统一于一个理论框架，揭示了同一市场内不同产品定价模式的互补性逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解新兴市场中的零售定价、质量信号与消费者搜索行为提供了统一分析工具，对市场设计与价格监管具有启示。

title: Pre-Construction Governance Failures in Municipal Infrastructure: A Practitioner Case Study from Tarash Municipality, Bangladesh

detail.title: Pre-Construction Governance Failures in Municipal Infrastructure: A Practitioner Case Study from Tarash Municipality, Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This paper examines two municipal road construction projects in Tarash Municipality, Sirajganj district, Bangladesh that experienced avoidable implementation delays during the 2023-2024 Annual Development Programme cycle. Drawing on municipal project files, contractor correspondence, engineering documentation, land records, and the author's direct experience as Administrator of the municipality, the study asks why projects that followed standard procurement procedures still encountered significant delays. The answer in both cases was the same: problems that were administratively knowable before tendering, roadside encroachment in one project, a government pond lease and boundary dispute in another, were not identified until after the contractor had mobilised. This produced delays of four and three months respectively, not because the problems were complex but because their late discovery forced design revisions, inter-agency coordination, and re-approval processes that could have been completed at the preparation stage at far lower cost. The paper argues that for smaller Bangladeshi municipalities, the weakest link in infrastructure delivery is pre-construction governance, the institutional tasks of mapping land use, engaging affected stakeholders, and coordinating with other agencies before a tender is issued. These tasks are not always systematically incorporated into local project preparation practices and may depend significantly on administrative discretion. Making them a formal, documented step in the ADP project cycle would reduce avoidable delays without requiring new institutions or significant additional resources.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对孟加拉国两个市政道路建设项目的案例分析，揭示了即使遵循标准采购程序，项目仍因前期可发现的问题（如路边侵占、土地纠纷等）未被提前识别而导致严重延误，提出"前期治理"是小型市政基础设施交付中最薄弱的环节。
AI.research_question: 为什么遵循标准采购程序的市政道路建设项目仍然遭遇了可避免的实施延误？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国小型市政项目中普遍存在可避免的实施延误，但现有研究较少关注"前期治理"（pre-construction governance）这一薄弱环节。作者以亲身参与的项目管理经验为基础，试图揭示延误的制度性根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目周期理论（Annual Development Programme cycle）；前期治理与实施效率的关系；行政裁量权在公共项目管理中的作用。
AI.method: 双案例比较研究；数据来源包括市政项目文件、承包商通信、工程文档、土地记录及作者作为市政行政官的亲身观察。
AI.findings: 两个项目的延误原因相同：本可在招标前通过行政途径知晓的问题（路边侵占、政府池塘租赁与边界争议）未被提前发现，导致承包商进场后被迫进行设计修改、跨机构协调和重新审批，分别造成4个月和3个月的延误。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"前期治理"概念化，指出在小型市政项目中，项目准备阶段的制度性任务（用地测绘、利益相关者参与、跨机构协调）是比采购程序更关键的效率瓶颈。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将前期治理任务（土地用途调查、利益相关方参与、跨机构协调）正式纳入ADP项目周期的标准化步骤，无需新建机构或大量额外资源即可有效减少可避免的延误。

title: Joint Probabilistic Forecasting for Battery Arbitrage in Day-Ahead Power Markets
affiliations: Bucharest University of Economic Studies, Department of Money and Banking and CEFIMO, Faculty of Finance and Banking, Bucharest University of Economic Studies, Department of Money and Banking and CEFIMO, Faculty of Finance and Banking, Bucharest University of Economic Studies, School of Business and Economics, Humboldt-University of Berlin, Bucharest University of Economic Studies, Bucharest, Romania, Bucharest University of Economic Studies and University of Applied Sciences for Engineering and Economics (HTW Berlin), School of Computing, Communication and Business

detail.title: Joint Probabilistic Forecasting for Battery Arbitrage in Day-Ahead Power Markets

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported ”IDA Institute of Digital Assets”, contract number CF166/15.11.2022, and the project “AI4EFin AI for Energy Finance”, contract number CF162/15.11.2022, financed under Romania’s National Recovery and Resilience Plan, Apel nr. PNRR-III-C9-2022-I8., COST Action ”Text, functional and other high-dimensional data in econometrics: New models, methods, applications” (HiTEc - CA21163).

detail.abstract: Battery energy storage (BESS) is widely considered essential for decarbonising power systems. In this research, we test whether short-term electricity price arbitrage generates sufficient returns to justify investment and BESS economic viability across four interconnected Central and Eastern European day-ahead markets-Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary, and the Czech Republic-from 2018 to 2024, accounting for realistic forecasting uncertainty. All four markets exhibit volatile, heavy-tailed prices and a pronounced daily price seasonality, creating opportunities for arbitrage. We generate joint probabilistic price forecasts using DRF (distributional random forests) and translate these into dayahead battery bidding decisions under real operating constraints. We compare performance with naïve and perfect-foresight benchmarks using standard investment metrics. Empirical findings confirm that probabilistic forecasting adds clear operational value, outperforming a fixed-schedule strategy in every market. The largest gains are seen in the Czech Republic and Bulgaria. Operating a battery in a cross-border setup generates additional profit, driven by persistent regional price differences rather than broad diversification. However, neither forecasting skill nor cross-market flexibility alone is sufficient to make the investment profitable. Therefore, current Li-ion BESS costs make realistic capital recovery unlikely, indicating that deeper market integration, cost reduction and additional revenue streams are necessary for viability.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了2018-2024年间中东欧四个互联电力市场中，基于概率预测的短期电价套利能否使电池储能投资实现经济可行性。结果表明，尽管概率预测和跨境运营能提升收益，但当前锂离子电池成本仍使投资难以盈利。
AI.research_question: 短期电价套利能否产生足够回报以证明电池储能投资的经济可行性？
AI.motivation: 电池储能被认为对电力系统脱碳至关重要，但其经济可行性面临挑战。现有研究较少考虑真实市场中的预测不确定性，需要基于实际运营约束进行检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电价套利理论、概率预测方法（分布随机森林DRF）、投资回报分析框架
AI.method: 使用DRF生成联合概率价格预测，将其转化为日前电池竞价决策（考虑实际运营约束），与朴素策略和完美预见基准比较，采用标准投资指标评估。
AI.findings: 1）概率预测在四个市场均优于固定调度策略，捷克和保加利亚收益最大；2）跨境运营通过区域价差而非广泛分散化产生额外利润；3）但无论预测能力还是跨境灵活性，均不足以使投资盈利，当前锂离子电池成本下资本回收不现实。
AI.theory_contributions: 在真实预测不确定性条件下检验了电池储能电价套利的经济可行性，揭示了概率预测的运营价值及其局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了实证依据：表明仅靠电价套利不足以支撑BESS投资，需要更深的市场一体化、成本降低和额外收入来源。

title: EMPLOYMENT BY SECTOR AND DEVELOPMENT IN INDIA FOR 1950-2020 AND INTERNATIONAL COMPARISONS WITH CHINA AND OECD COUNTRIES

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial support

keywords: Population and Development of India for 1950-2020

detail.abstract: We have into account production by sector and its effects on employment and productivity. We present a comparison of data with other economies, as China, Japan and some European countries, regarding some indicators of development and welfate. We include references to some interesting econometric models of Employment by sector in India and in other countries and we focus on the trends to diminution of Farm Employment and increase in Non Farm Employment. We highlight the important effects of industrial production on general productivity of workers, real income per capita and poverty diminution, as well as the positive effects, on development, of increase of schooling and social capital. For the next decade: 2021-2030, we conclude that there are good opportunities for advances on economic development in India and that good economic policies addressed to foster international investments and cooperation for the creation of Non Farm Employment in India may have a positive impact both for urban and rural areas.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度各行业生产对就业和生产率的影响，通过与其他经济体（中国、日本及部分欧洲国家）的比较，重点关注农业就业下降和非农就业上升的趋势，并指出工业产出、教育水平和社会资本对经济发展具有正向推动作用。研究预测2021-2030年印度经济发展机遇良好，通过吸引国际投资和合作创造非农就业将惠及城乡地区。
AI.research_question: 印度各行业生产如何影响就业结构与生产率？非农就业增长对印度经济发展的作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解印度经济转型过程中农业就业下降与非农就业上升的趋势及其对发展指标的长期影响，为未来十年（2021-2030）的经济政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业就业结构转型理论、生产率与收入增长关系理论、人力资本与社会资本理论
AI.method: 跨国比较分析（中国、日本、欧洲）、行业就业计量经济模型引用、描述性统计分析
AI.findings: 印度农业就业持续下降、非农就业上升；工业产出提升工人整体生产率；教育水平和社会资本增加促进发展；未来十年印度具备良好经济发展机遇。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家产业转型与就业结构变迁提供印度案例证据，丰富了农业-非农就业转型的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议印度政府通过吸引国际投资与合作创造非农就业岗位，以推动城乡共同发展。

title:
Externalized Economy, Externalized Security
Japan's Forced Evolution from a Security-outsourced Economic State to a Networked Stabilizer of the Western Pacific

detail.title:
Externalized Economy, Externalized Security
Japan's Forced Evolution from a Security-outsourced Economic State to a Networked Stabilizer of the Western Pacific

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or conflicts of interest related to this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human subjects, patient data, clinical materials, interviews, surveys, or experiments requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that Japan's contemporary transformation is best understood not as a voluntary return to militarism or a simple continuation of postwar passivity, but as a forced adaptation to the externalization of its own economic system. Postwar Japan functioned as a security-outsourced economic state: the United States supplied the hard infrastructure of regional security while Japan specialized in manufacturing, technology, finance, export competitiveness, and domestic social organization. That settlement is now under pressure because Japan's economic reproduction increasingly depends on external energy routes, production networks, critical minerals, semiconductor chains, maritime corridors, labor channels, and overseas assets. The paper develops a conditional mechanism: externalized economy produces pressure for externalized security when external inputs become costly to substitute, domestic reproductive capacity weakens, and the state possesses sufficient institutional capacity to act outward. The Japanese case is therefore not only a story of threat response. It is a case of economic externalization becoming a security problem. Historical comparison clarifies the mechanism. Similar Japan-Asia-Pacific complementarities were channeled in the 1930s through depression, protectionism, military autonomy, and revisionist order-building into coercive empire. Contemporary Japan faces different channeling conditions: higher legitimacy constraints, alliance embedding, partner agency, supply-chain security, and the high cost of war. The result is not territorial command, but movement toward a security-industrial state, a networked stabilizer, and a new layer of financial recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文论证当代日本转型既非自愿回归军国主义，也非战后被动状态的延续，而是其经济体系外部化迫使安全政策被迫适应的结果。战后日本作为"安全外包型经济国家"，依赖美国提供安全基础设施。如今经济再生产高度依赖外部能源、供应链、矿产、半导体、海上通道等，形成"外部化经济→外部化安全压力"的传导机制。与1930年代相比，当代日本面临不同的约束条件，走向"安全产业国家"而非领土帝国。
AI.research_question: 日本当代转型的本质是什么？经济外部化如何驱动安全政策的变化？
AI.motivation: 现有解释将日本转型归结为"回归军国主义"或"被动延续和平主义"都不准确，需要提出新的理论框架来解释日本安全政策的深层动因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件机制理论：外部化经济产生外部化安全压力的三个条件——外部投入替代成本高、国内再生产能力弱、国家具备足够制度能力向外行动。历史比较框架：对比1930年代与当代日本的相似互补性但不同的渠道条件。
AI.method: 理论建构与历史比较分析
AI.findings: 当代日本走向"安全产业国家"和"网络化稳定器"，而非领土帝国。原因在于合法性约束、联盟嵌入、伙伴能动性、供应链安全要求、战争高成本等渠道条件不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"经济外部化成为安全问题"的理论机制，将经济依赖与安全政策变化之间的因果关系条件化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解日本安全政策演变、中美日三边关系、以及东亚区域秩序变化提供分析框架。
