title: Intellectual Property Rights in Agriculture: The Missing Ingredient? An Examination of the Role of Intellectual Property in Enhancing Economic Returns in Agriculture in Trinidad and Tobago

detail.title: Intellectual Property Rights in Agriculture: The Missing Ingredient? An Examination of the Role of Intellectual Property in Enhancing Economic Returns in Agriculture in Trinidad and Tobago

publicationDetails.detailsText: The UWI St. Augustine Law Journal, Volume 4 No. 1 pp 55 - 77

detail.abstract: Agriculture, although a staple in Caribbean societies, is dwindling. Research indicates that regional agricultural output is appreciably miniscule in comparison to agricultural imports. While not thoroughly examined locally, it has been postulated that agriculture in Trinidad and Tobago has the potential to be elevated by IPR application. Notwithstanding the potential challenges that may arise, this article argues that IPRs in both the primary and secondary sectors of agricultural production can be used to enhance the economic viability thereof.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了通过知识产权（IPR）在农业初级和次级生产部门的应用，来提升特立尼达和多巴哥农业经济可行性的潜力。
AI.research_question: 知识产权（IPR）如何应用于特立尼达和多巴哥农业的初级和次级生产部门，以提升其经济可行性？
AI.motivation: 加勒比地区农业日益萎缩，区域农业产出远低于农业进口量，亟需探索提升农业经济活力的途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权（IPR）在农业领域应用的理论框架，涵盖初级部门（如植物品种保护）和次级部门（如加工技术专利、地理标志等）。
AI.method: 理论论证与文献分析，结合特立尼达和多巴哥的农业与知识产权现状进行论述。
AI.findings: 知识产权可以在农业初级和次级生产部门中得到应用，尽管存在潜在挑战，但仍可有效提升农业的经济可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了知识产权理论在发展中国家农业经济领域的适用性分析，特别是针对小岛屿发展中国家的农业转型问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特立尼达和多巴哥及其他加勒比国家利用知识产权工具振兴农业提供了政策建议和实践路径。

title: Measuring Firm-Level Currency Exposure
affiliations: and

detail.title: Measuring Firm-Level Currency Exposure

publicationDetails.journalName: University of Cambridge Faculty of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop DoEx, a firm-quarter measure of currency exposure, built from how intensively managers and analysts discuss the currency environment—exchange-rate levels, volatility, and the dollar’s direction—on quarterly earnings conference calls for 8,294 U.S.-listed firms over 2007–2024. DoEx tracks every major dollar episode of the period and rises with firms’ real international footprints, and carries information well beyond alternative currency-exposure proxies, including foreign-sales ratios and return-based FX betas. Firms with higher exposure experience equity-price declines when the dollar appreciates, and they act on this exposure by using more FX derivatives and tilting their borrowing toward non-USD-denominated debt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的货币风险暴露度量指标DoEx，基于2007-2024年间8,294家美国上市公司季度财报电话会议中管理层和分析师对汇率环境（汇率水平、波动性及美元走势）的讨论强度构建。DoEx能够追踪美元所有主要波动时期，与企业的真实国际足迹相关，并包含超越传统货币风险暴露衡量指标（如海外销售比率和基于回报的外汇贝塔）的增量信息。高暴露企业在美元升值时股价下跌，并通过使用更多外汇衍生品和增加非美元债务融资来应对风险。
AI.research_question: 如何利用企业财报电话会议中的语言信息，更有效地衡量企业的货币风险暴露程度？
AI.motivation: 传统的货币风险暴露衡量方法（如海外销售比率和基于股票回报的外汇贝塔）存在局限性，不能充分捕捉企业面临的真实汇率风险。而企业管理层和分析师在财报电话会议中对汇率环境的讨论，可能蕴含着更丰富、更及时的风险暴露信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和风险管理理论，认为企业决策者（管理层）和外部信息中介（分析师）对汇率环境的关注程度反映了企业的实际风险暴露水平。
AI.method: 利用自然语言处理技术，对2007-2024年间8,294家美国上市公司季度财报电话会议文本进行分析，构建基于讨论强度的货币风险暴露指标DoEx。
AI.findings: (1) DoEx能够准确追踪美元所有主要波动时期；(2) DoEx与企业的真实国际足迹正相关；(3) DoEx包含超越传统衡量指标（海外销售比率、外汇贝塔）的增量信息；(4) 高DoEx企业在美元升值时股价显著下跌；(5) 高暴露企业通过增加外汇衍生品使用和非美元债务融资来对冲风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用财报电话会议文本中的讨论强度构建货币风险暴露指标，拓展了风险管理领域的测度方法，验证了文本信息在衡量企业风险暴露方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管者和企业管理者提供了更精准的货币风险暴露度量工具，有助于更有效地进行风险管理决策和投资分析。

title: DTPP-Ω: A Decentralized Trust Propagation Protocol for Autonomous Agent Ecosystems

detail.title: DTPP-Ω: A Decentralized Trust Propagation Protocol for Autonomous Agent Ecosystems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently under the WHYLD research division of XWHYZ (UAE-registered). The author holds no financial interest in any protocol, platform, or technology described in this paper. No advisory, consulting, or employment relationship exists with any organization that would benefit commercially from the adoption of DTPP-Ω.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a technical protocol architecture and does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical studies, surveys, interviews, or any form of empirical data collection involving persons. No ethics approval is required. All analysis is theoretical, formal, and architecture-based. No personal data of any kind was collected, processed, or referenced in this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was self-funded and conducted independently under the WHYLD research division of XWHYZ, a UAE-registered research and advisory entity founded and directed by the author. No grant, institutional funding, or commercial sponsorship was received or sought in connection with this paper.

detail.abstract: Autonomous agent ecosystems operating at civilizational scale require a trust layer that does not exist in contemporary agentic stacks. Identity protocols establish who an agent is. Permission systems gate what an agent may execute. Neither addresses how trust propagates between agents across a decentralized mesh without a central authority. This paper introduces DTPP-Ω (Decentralized Trust Propagation Protocol, Omega Architecture), a protocol designed to operate across the period 2026-2100. DTPP-Ω is built on eleven constitutional invariants, nine architectural components, a two-phase authorization engine, a bounded trust budget system, an influence graph layer, and a fully specified sentinel governance mechanism. The protocol's core design objective is trustworthy operation under uncertainty-not maximum trust, but bounded, explainable, auditable, locally computed, influence-aware trust that degrades gracefully under adversarial conditions. The architecture is motivated by back casting analysis identifying the absence of an inter-agent trust propagation layer as a probable cause of hypothesized civilizational-scale alignment failures between 2039 and 2042.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DTPP-Ω协议，一个面向2026-2100年的大规模去中心化自治智能体生态系统的信任传播协议，旨在解决无中心权威环境下智能体间的信任传递问题。
AI.research_question: 在没有中央权威的去中心化网络中，智能体之间的信任如何传递和计算，以支持文明规模的自治智能体生态系统?
AI.motivation: 回测分析表明，缺乏智能体间信任传播层可能是2039-2042年间假想的文明规模对齐失败的根本原因。现有的身份协议和权限系统无法解决去中心化网格中的信任传递问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 十一个宪法不变量、两个阶段授权引擎、有限信任预算系统、影响力图层的架构设计，以及哨兵治理机制。
AI.method: 协议设计方法，基于回测分析(back casting analysis)，构建包括十一个宪法不变量、九个架构组件、两阶段授权引擎、有限信任预算系统、影响力图层的完整协议架构。
AI.findings: DTPP-Ω协议的核心设计目标是在不确定性下实现可信操作——不是最大化信任，而是实现有界、可解释、可审计、本地计算、影响力感知的信任，并在对抗条件下优雅降级。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个面向超长期(2026-2100年)的去中心化信任传播协议架构，将信任问题从中心化权威范式转向本地计算、有界预算、影响力感知的去中心化范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文明规模自治智能体生态系统提供了可操作的信任层设计方案，包括具体的协议组件(宪法不变量、授权引擎、信任预算、影响力图层、哨兵治理)以解决现实中的智能体间信任传递问题。

title: Arbitrage Opportunities
affiliations: Leibniz University Hannover and Leibniz University Hannover

detail.title: Arbitrage Opportunities

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the German Research Foundation (DFG) [grant number 510760579]

detail.abstract: In this paper, we study the emergence and elimination of arbitrage opportunities in computerized limit order markets. We measure price changes, buy/sell market/limit order submissions/cancellations at message frequency during arbitrage opportunities in NYMEX WTI futures and options using their model-free no-arbitrage relation. We find that executed arbitrage trades in all three markets during the life of an arbitrage opportunity are virtually nonexistent. In the more liquid futures market, executed trades eliminate arbitrage, whereas in the options markets, liquidity providers are the ones who correct arbitrage opportunities. These results highlight the critical role of liquidity providers in maintaining price efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了计算机化限价订单市场中套利机会的出现与消除机制。通过分析NYMEX WTI期货与期权市场中无模型无套利关系下的高频消息数据，发现套利机会期间几乎不存在执行套利交易。在流动性更强的期货市场中，执行交易消除了套利；而在期权市场中，流动性提供者纠正了套利机会。研究突显了流动性提供者在维持价格效率中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 在计算机化限价订单市场中，套利机会是如何出现并被消除的？不同流动性水平的市场（期货 vs 期权）是否存在不同的套利消除机制？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为套利交易者的执行交易会消除套利机会，但在计算机化限价订单市场中，套利消除的具体机制尚未被充分理解。特别是在不同流动性水平的市场中，套利消除方式可能存在差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无套利定价理论、市场微观结构理论、流动性提供者理论
AI.method: 使用高频消息级数据（包括价格变化、买卖市场/限价订单提交/取消），分析NYMEX WTI期货与期权在套利机会期间的交易行为，比较不同市场中的套利消除机制。
AI.findings: 1. 套利机会期间几乎不存在执行套利交易；2. 在流动性更强的期货市场中，执行交易消除了套利；3. 在期权市场中，流动性提供者（而非套利交易者）纠正了套利机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同流动性水平市场中套利消除机制的本质差异，挑战了套利交易者执行交易是唯一套利消除途径的传统观念，理论贡献在于将流动性提供者的角色纳入套利定价理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场监管者提供了理解市场效率维持机制的新视角，提示在流动性较低的市场中，激励流动性提供者对于维护价格效率至关重要。

title: The Beautiful Game And The Inattentive Market: Global Culture, the FIFA World Cup, and Investor Attention in the U.S. Stock Market
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Beautiful Game And The Inattentive Market: Global Culture, the FIFA World Cup, and Investor Attention in the U.S. Stock Market
detail.abstract: The FIFA World Cup is the most watched sporting event in human history, drawing over five billion viewers globally across its tournament weeks. Its economic footprint is staggering: the 2026 edition, hosted across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, is projected to generate up to $80 billion in global gross output and $40.9 billion in global GDP impact. Yet alongside this extraordinary commercial vitality lies a paradox of profound importance for financial economists: the same cultural phenomenon that generates billions in revenue appears to simultaneously withdraw investor attention from financial markets, compressing trading volume, depressing market sentiment, and producing measurable negative abnormal returns in the U.S. stock market during the tournament months of June and July. This paper examines the dual economic identity of the FIFA World Cup, as a generator of global commercial activity and as a systematic disruptor of investor attention. We review the theoretical foundations of limited attention in financial markets, survey the empirical literature on the World Cup effect across national equity markets, analyze the specific dynamics of U.S. market behavior during World Cup months compared to equivalent non-World Cup periods, and document the channels through which the tournament transmits its effects: sentiment, distraction, and gambling spillover. Our findings contribute to behavioral finance by framing the World Cup as a natural experiment in mass cognitive reallocation with predictable, measurable, and exploitable financial consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了FIFA世界杯作为全球最盛大的体育赛事，在创造巨额商业价值的同时，却通过转移投资者注意力、压缩交易量、压低市场情绪，导致美国股市在赛事期间出现显著的负异常收益。研究将世界杯界定为一场大规模认知重新分配的自然实验，具有可预测、可测量且可利用的金融后果。
AI.research_question: FIFA世界杯如何在作为全球商业活动引擎的同时，又作为投资者注意力的系统性干扰因素影响美国股票市场？其传导渠道是什么？
AI.motivation: 世界杯创造了数十亿美元的经济产出，却在同一时期对金融市场产生负面冲击，这一悖论对金融经济学家具有重要研究价值，有助于理解注意力有限性在资产定价中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限注意力理论、行为金融学中的注意力分配与市场效率假说、认知资源重新分配理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析框架。通过回顾有限注意力理论在金融市场中的理论基础，梳理世界杯效应在各国家股票市场的实证文献，并对比分析美国市场在世界杯月份与非世界杯月份的行为差异。
AI.findings: 世界杯期间（6-7月）美国股市出现可测量的负异常收益；交易量压缩、市场情绪低迷；赛事通过情绪冲击、注意力分散和赌博溢出三个渠道传导其市场影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将世界杯界定为"大规模认知重新分配的自然实验"，为行为金融学中注意力有限性假设提供了宏大且可量化的实证场景，拓展了注意力分散事件对资产定价影响的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了在世界杯期间可操作的交易策略参考（如规避或对冲周期性风险）；为市场监管者理解非经济事件对市场效率的干扰提供了实证依据。

title: SOVEREIGN Counsel: Attributable Judgment, Fractional Models, and NULL Drift in Legal Services

detail.title: SOVEREIGN Counsel: Attributable Judgment, Fractional Models, and NULL Drift in Legal Services
detail.abstract:
This paper applies the Burgess Principle's binary test — SOVEREIGN, where a named human mind demonstrably applied judgment to the specific facts of a matter before an output issued; NULL, where no such application can be evidenced — to legal services. Legal representation occupies a distinctive position in the framework: it is the professional layer most often asked to convert institutional NULL gaps into owned decisions, and is therefore the layer whose own attributability matters most.

The paper operationalizes the test for solicitor work, specifying four evidentiary markers that constitute demonstrated application of judgment and establishing who is positioned to score them. It then identifies the structural drivers of NULL drift in traditional engagements — volume incentives, template correspondence, delegation without recorded review, and failure to engage client-specific constraints, including Equality Act 2010 reasonable adjustments. These dynamics are illustrated through an abstracted composite engagement drawn from a documented instructed relationship.

The fractional or project-scoped solicitor model is examined as a structurally higher-SOVEREIGN-density alternative, with the evidentiary basis and rival explanations stated explicitly. A five-element remediation protocol, adapted from the framework's prior application to institutional failure, allows any client to score an engagement for SOVEREIGN compliance. A concluding analysis extends the test to machine-assisted self-representation, arguing that the self-represented litigant operating a record-complete, constraint-embodying workflow satisfies the test's authorship requirement in its purest available form. The paper concludes that legal services must themselves be capable of passing the test they are routinely asked to enforce on others.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Burgess原则的二元测试（SOVEREIGN vs NULL）分析法律服务，指出律师工作存在结构性NULL漂移（如数量激励、模板通信、无记录审查的委托等），并提出分数制/项目制律师模式作为更高SOVEREIGN密度的替代方案，最终论证法律服务本身必须通过其常要求他人遵守的测试。
AI.research_question: 法律服务（尤其是律师代理工作）在多大程度上能够通过Burgess原则的SOVEREIGN测试？律师工作中的结构性NULL漂移如何产生，以及如何通过替代模型和补救协议加以纠正？
AI.motivation: 法律代理是连接制度性NULL空白与可归属决策的关键专业层，但其自身的可归责性（attributability）却最值得关注。本文动机在于揭示律师工作中普遍存在的非人格化决策问题，并提出可操作的改进方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: Burgess原则的二元测试框架：SOVEREIGN（有证据表明具名人类心智对事实做出了判断）与NULL（无此类证据）。该框架最初用于分析制度失败，本文将其扩展至法律服务领域。
AI.method: 概念分析：将SOVEREIGN/NULL测试操作化为律师工作的四项证据标记；案例分析：基于已记录委托关系中的抽象化综合案例；比较分析：传统律师模型与分数制/项目制律师模型对比；协议设计：提出五项修复协议供客户评估SOVEREIGN合规性。
AI.findings: 传统律师聘用模式存在四种结构性NULL漂移动力：数量激励、模板通信、无记录审查的委托、未考虑客户特定约束（包括《2010年平等法》合理调整）。分数制/项目制律师模型具有更高的SOVEREIGN密度。自助式诉讼人若运行记录完整、约束体现的工作流程，其作者身份要求反而最为纯粹。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Burgess原则的SOVEREIGN/NULL二元测试从制度分析领域扩展至专业法律服务领域；为律师工作中的决策归因问题提供了可操作的实证标记体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为客户提供了五项可操作的修复协议以评估律师服务的SOVEREIGN合规性；指出了分数制/项目制律师模式作为更优实践方向；揭示了传统律所收费模式与决策质量之间的结构性张力。

title: Differential Ire: Why Attributable Governance Harms Sustain Public Accountability Pressure That Diffuse Scandals Do Not: An Application of the Burgess Principle

detail.title: Differential Ire: Why Attributable Governance Harms Sustain Public Accountability Pressure That Diffuse Scandals Do Not: An Application of the Burgess Principle
detail.abstract: This paper examines an observable asymmetry in public response to institutional harm. Harms that the public can trace to identifiable human decisions-a sign-off, a refusal, an operational choice made at a discrete moment-generate accountability pressure that is more intense, more durable, and more institutionally consequential than harms of equal or greater aggregate magnitude that remain diffuse. The paper applies the Burgess Principle's binary test (SOVEREIGN: a named human mind demonstrably applied to the specific facts; NULL: no such application can be evidenced) as a descriptive instrument for predicting which harms enter the first category. Two historical clusters (Grenfell Tower, Hillsborough, the infected blood scandal, and the Post Office Horizon scandal, contrasted with the Madoff fraud and the opioid epidemic) and one contemporary case-the murder of Henry Nowak in Southampton in December 2025 and the subsequent scrutiny of the police response-are reviewed strictly on the established public record. The Horizon scandal is treated as a boundary case that refines the thesis: durability of public ire tracks the combination of attributability and irrecoverability of harm, with death the limiting instance of irrecoverability rather than a separate variable. The paper argues throughout that NULL is a measurement, not an accusation: it identifies where no named judgment can be evidenced, and predicts that such gaps, once attached to irrecoverable harm, become focal points of sustained public ire. The paper closes with a five-element remediation protocol-stated generally, so that any institution's post-failure response can itself be scored SOVEREIGN or NULL-before addressing limitations, alternative explanations, and the risk of political co-option of attributable cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个观察性不对称现象：公众对可归因于特定人类决策的机构伤害（SOVEREIGN型）的反应，比对同等或更大规模但分散模糊的伤害（NULL型）更强烈、持久且具有制度后果。通过历史案例和现代案例的分析，论文论证了伤害的可归因性与不可挽回性的结合是决定公众愤怒持久度的关键，并提出了一个五要素修复协议来评估机构的回应。
AI.research_question: 为什么公众对可归因于特定人类决策的机构伤害与对分散模糊的机构伤害的反应存在显著不对称？这种不对称如何影响问责压力和制度后果？
AI.motivation: 观察到公众对不同类型机构伤害的反应存在系统性差异，但这种差异未被充分理论化。作者旨在提供一个描述性工具（伯格原则的二元检验）来解释和预测这种不对称性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伯格原则及其SOVEREIGN/NULL二元检验（SOVEREIGN：可证明有具体人类心智应用于特定事实；NULL：无此类证据）。论文还将伤害的"可归因性"（attributability）与"不可挽回性"（irrecoverability）作为核心变量，以死亡作为不可挽回性的极限情况。
AI.method: 案例分析：对比两组历史案例集群（Grenfell Tower、Hillsborough、受污染血液丑闻、Post Office Horizon丑闻 vs. Madoff欺诈、阿片类药物泛滥），以及一个当代案例（2025年12月南安普顿Henry Nowak谋杀案及警方回应审查）。Post Office Horizon丑闻作为边界案例来完善论点。
AI.findings: 可归因于具体人类决策的伤害（SOVEREIGN型）引发的问责压力比同等或更大规模但分散的伤害（NULL型）更强烈、持久且具有制度后果。公众愤怒的持久度取决于伤害的可归因性与不可挽回性的结合，死亡是不可挽回性的极限而非独立变量。NULL不是一个指控，而是一个测量：它识别出无法证明有具体判断的缺口，这些缺口一旦与不可挽回的伤害挂钩，就会成为公众持续愤怒的焦点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个描述性二元框架（伯格原则）用于预测哪些机构伤害会引发强烈公众反应。将可归因性与不可挽回性确立为解释公众愤怒持久度的核心变量，并澄清了死亡在此框架中的角色（不可挽回性的极限，而非独立变量）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个五要素修复协议，可用于评估任何机构在失败后的回应（可被评分为SOVEREIGN或NULL）。提醒注意政治力量对可归因案例的"劫持"（co-option）风险，为机构危机管理提供了可操作的工具。

title: Investment Decisions, Voluntary Disclosure, Myopia, and Bounded Inefficiency
affiliations: Leonard N. Stern School of Business, New York University, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Stanford University - Stanford Graduate School of Business and Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Jerusalem School of Business Administration

detail.title: Investment Decisions, Voluntary Disclosure, Myopia, and Bounded Inefficiency
detail.abstract: We study a voluntary disclosure setting in which a manager privately observes the values of two mutually exclusive projects, only one of which generates verifiable and disclosable short-term information. The disclosable project offers an option value that the non-disclosable project does not, so myopic incentives tilt project choice toward the disclosable project. We show that even when the manager cares almost exclusively about the short-term price, the efficiency loss is small relative to the first-best outcome. By identifying conditions under which short-term pricing pressure has limited real consequences, the model may explain why empirical estimates of myopia-induced investment distortions are often small.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了经理在观察到两个互斥项目的私人信息后，其中一个项目可产生可验证且可披露的短期信息。即使经理几乎只关心短期股价，效率损失相对于最优结果也很小，解释了为何经验估计中短视导致的投资扭曲往往较小。
AI.research_question: 当经理拥有两个互斥项目的私人信息（仅一个项目可产生可验证的短期披露信息）时，短期价格压力如何影响经理的项目选择及其效率损失？
AI.motivation: 经验证据显示短视导致的投资扭曲幅度较小，但理论上短期压力应导致严重扭曲。本文旨在弥合理论与实证之间的差距，解释为何短期主义对实际投资决策的负面影响有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自愿披露理论与短视经理模型（myopia model）；期权价值理论；信号博弈框架
AI.method: 博弈论模型分析（voluntary disclosure setting），通过数学推导刻画经理在短期价格压力下的项目选择均衡，比较效率损失与最优结果。
AI.findings: 即使经理几乎只关心短期股价，效率损失相对于一阶最优结果也很小；存在使得短期价格压力对实际经济后果有限的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 为短期价格压力为何只导致很小效率损失提供了理论解释；建立了短视激励与项目选择之间关系的正式模型，补充了自愿披露与投资效率相关的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了为何经验研究中短视导致的投资扭曲往往较小，为政策制定者和企业管理者理解短期主义的影响提供了理论依据。

title: The FDA’s New Clinical Decision Support Software Guidance and Its Implications for Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of Illinois College of Law

detail.title: The FDA’s New Clinical Decision Support Software Guidance and Its Implications for Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Sara Gerke is a member of the Bayer Bioethics Council. She is also a Research Fellow at the University of Copenhagen, Faculty of Law, supported by a Novo Nordisk Foundation Grant for a scientifically independent International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme (Inter-CeBIL programme - grant no. NNF23SA0087056).
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by the European Union (Grant Agreement no. 101057321 and no. 101057099). Views and opinions expressed are, however, those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the Health and Digital Executive Agency. Neither the European Union nor the granting authority can be held responsible for them. This work was also funded by the Richard W. Corman and Marie L. Corman Law Summer Research Scholar appointment.

detail.abstract:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming healthcare. While the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has authorized the marketing of more than 1,400 AI-based products classified as devices under Section 201(h)(1) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, many other AI-based products, including certain clinical decision support (CDS) software tools that provide recommendations to health care professionals about diagnosis, treatment, or prevention of a disease or condition, have been placed on the U.S. market without FDA premarket review. On January 6, 2026, the FDA issued a revised CDS Guidance, which superseded the September 28, 2022 CDS Guidance. Shortly after, the agency issued the January 29, 2026 CDS Guidance, which superseded the January 6, 2026 CDS Guidance.

This Article systematically examines and compares three versions of the CDS Guidance: (1) the 2022 CDS Guidance, (2) the January 6, 2026 CDS Guidance, and (3) the January 29, 2026 CDS Guidance. It identifies key changes between the three versions and analyzes their implications for CDS using AI (AI-based CDS). In particular, this Article argues that since the 2022 CDS Guidance, the FDA’s overall trend has been to expand the scope of AI-based CDS that do not meet the device definition and of those that are devices but for which the agency intends to exercise enforcement discretion. As a result, an increasing number of AI-based CDS, including Generative AI-based CDS, can enter the U.S. market without FDA premarket review, leading to a lack of transparency as well as safety and effectiveness concerns.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了FDA在2022年、2026年1月6日和2026年1月29日发布的三个版本的临床决策支持（CDS）指南，发现FDA的总体趋势是不断扩大免于上市前审查的AI-based CDS范围，导致越来越多的AI产品（包括生成式AI）无需FDA审查即可进入美国市场，引发透明度和安全有效性方面的担忧。
AI.research_question: FDA三个版本的CDS指南如何改变了AI-based CDS产品的监管范围？这些变化对AI医疗产品的市场准入、透明度和安全性有何影响？
AI.motivation: FDA在短时间内连续发布三版CDS指南（2022年、2026年1月6日、2026年1月29日），监管政策频繁变动，亟需系统梳理和比较这些变化，以揭示FDA对AI-based CDS的监管趋势及其潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗器械监管框架（FD&C Act第201(h)(1)条的设备定义）、FDA执法裁量权理论、AI医疗产品的风险分级监管理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律文本分析与比较研究方法，系统对比三个版本的CDS指南文本，识别关键条款的变化并分析其政策含义。
AI.findings: 自2022年CDS指南以来，FDA的总体趋势是扩大两类AI-based CDS的范围：（1）不符合设备定义的AI-based CDS；（2）虽属设备但FDA打算行使执法裁量权的AI-based CDS。这使得越来越多的AI-based CDS（包括生成式AI）可以免于FDA上市前审查直接进入美国市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了FDA在AI医疗产品监管中"监管放松"的理论趋势，为理解行政机构如何通过指南文件实质性地改变监管边界提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗AI企业、医疗服务提供者和政策制定者提供了FDA监管政策变化的系统梳理，警示了AI-based CDS缺乏上市前审查可能带来的透明度和安全有效性风险。

title: The Fragility of Semi-Liquid Private Credit Funds
affiliations: Drexel University, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School - Finance Department  and

detail.title: The Fragility of Semi-Liquid Private Credit Funds
detail.abstract: We study fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, which have expanded rapidly and now manage over $300 billion in assets. These funds perform liquidity transformation by holding far more illiquid loans than traditional loan mutual funds while allowing investors to redeem at NAV through quarterly repurchase offers, typically capped at 5% of shares outstanding. We show that cash buffers and contractual loan repayments are insufficient to fund repeated 5% quarterly redemptions; inflows decline precisely when outflows rise; and net outflows are met with sales of illiquid loans, external borrowing, and delayed payments through repurchases payable. As a result, strategic complementarity arises, because redemptions impose liquidation and leverage costs on the remaining investors. We show that loan liquidation, leverage increase, and NAV inflation play an important role in amplifying the current episodes of run-like redemptions. Overall, our evidence suggests that quarterly gates and redemption caps do not eliminate run-like fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, raising cautions about expanding retail access to private credit markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性，发现季度赎回限制和赎回上限无法消除类似银行挤兑的脆弱性，现金缓冲和合同贷款还款不足以应对持续赎回，赎回会产生清算成本和杠杆成本，加剧投资者之间的策略互补性，导致挤兑式赎回。
AI.research_question: 半流动性私募信贷基金的挤兑脆弱性机制是什么？季度赎回限制和赎回上限能否有效防止挤兑？
AI.motivation: 半流动性私募信贷基金管理资产超3000亿美元且快速增长，但其流动性转换特征（持有大量非流动性贷款、允许季度赎回）可能带来系统性风险，需要深入研究其脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性转换理论、策略互补性理论、挤兑模型
AI.method: 实证分析，使用基金层面的数据检验现金流缓冲、贷款偿还、赎回模式、资产清算、杠杆变化和NAV通胀等机制。
AI.findings: 1）现金缓冲和合同贷款还款不足以应对重复的5%季度赎回；2）资金流入在流出上升时反而下降；3）净流出导致非流动性贷款出售、外部借款和延迟支付；4）赎回对剩余投资者产生清算成本和杠杆成本，形成策略互补性；5）贷款清算、杠杆增加和NAV通胀放大了挤兑式赎回；6）季度申购窗口和赎回上限未能消除挤兑脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将挤兑脆弱性分析拓展到半流动性私募信贷基金领域，揭示了即使存在赎回限制和赎回上限，挤兑风险依然存在，丰富了流动性转换和金融脆弱性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和投资者提供警示：半流动性私募信贷基金并非如设计初衷那样安全，扩大零售投资者参与私募信贷市场需谨慎；建议重新评估季度赎回机制和赎回上限的有效性。

reference: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 18/2026
title: Circular Economy Relationships in French and Italian NUTS 2 Regions: A Multi-Attribute Analysis
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia, Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and Ca’ Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Circular Economy Relationships in French and Italian NUTS 2 Regions: A Multi-Attribute Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 18/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The research question aims to present the current state of the CE in NUTS 2 regions within France and Italy, top circularity performers in the EU, aiming to highlight the relationships and patterns among the reduce, reuse, recycle and socioeconomic indicators used to describe the circular economy, and to identify opportune instruments/policies to keep materials and products in circulation for as long as possible and to ensure sustainable development. This necessitates the definition of new development models and leads to decision problems in the public sector. To achieve this, understanding the socioeconomic and environmental situation of a territorial area is vital. Using Eurostat indicators and considering disposal and recovery facilities' numbers, a composite index (Waste Index) is identified and used as a decision attribute, alongside sustainability indicators as conditional attributes within the Multi-Attribute Analysis framework. This way, relationships and patterns are expressed as decision rules. Specific indicators in the decision rules, especially in the "reduce" analysis, like fertilizers and water-induced soil erosion, are crucial. Surprisingly, in the "reuse" analysis, the number of businesses for repairing computers and vehicles appears infrequently. When considering economic and social aspect, attributes like broadband access and tertiary education play significant roles in decision rules, while the employment rate never appears.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多属性分析框架，通过构建废物指数作为决策属性，以法国和意大利NUTS 2区域的循环经济现状为研究对象，揭示了减少、再利用、回收与社会经济指标之间的关系与模式，并识别出关键政策工具。
AI.research_question: 法国和意大利NUTS 2区域（欧盟循环经济表现最佳地区）的循环经济现状如何？减少、再利用、回收与社会经济指标之间存在怎样的关系与模式？哪些政策工具可以有效延长材料和产品的循环使用并确保可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 需要定义新的发展模式以应对公共部门的决策问题，而理解区域的社会经济和环境状况是实现循环经济和可持续发展的关键前提。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多属性分析框架（Multi-Attribute Analysis）
AI.method: 利用Eurostat指标以及处置和回收设施数量，构建复合指数（废物指数）作为决策属性，以可持续发展指标作为条件属性，通过决策规则表达关系和模式。
AI.findings: 1) "减少"分析中，化肥和水引起的土壤侵蚀等指标至关重要；2) "再利用"分析中，计算机和车辆维修企业数量出现频率较低；3) 宽带接入和高等教育在经济与社会方面作用显著，而就业率从未出现在决策规则中。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多属性分析框架应用于循环经济研究，通过决策规则揭示了循环经济指标与社会经济指标之间的隐性关系模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法国和意大利的区域循环经济政策制定提供了基于数据分析的决策依据，识别了关键的政策干预点（如化肥使用、土壤侵蚀、宽带接入和高等教育）。

title: The Price of Carry: Funding Frictions, Parity Failures, and Crash Risk
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and HEC Paris - Finance Department

detail.title: The Price of Carry: Funding Frictions, Parity Failures, and Crash Risk
detail.abstract: Building on Brunnermeier et al. (2009), we show that FX carry remains profitable in a broad USD-funded universe, but post-2006 performance is weaker and strongly left-tailed. UIP failures explain the average premium: high-yield currencies do not depreciate enough to offset interest-rate differentials. CIP deviations reveal when those returns become fragile: after Lehman's collapse, the cross-currency basis turns structurally negative, and larger dislocations predict future downside asymmetry. Option-implied moments add ex ante evidence that funding stress and crash risk are priced before they materialize. Sovereign bond carry does not improve the trade-off, as duration and yield-curve risks are poorly compensated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美元融资环境下外汇套利交易的盈利性及其风险特征，发现其虽仍有利可图，但2006年后表现减弱且呈现强左尾分布。未覆盖利率平价失效解释了平均溢价，而交叉货币基差在雷曼事件后结构性转负，预示了回报脆弱性。期权隐含矩提供了事前证据，主权债券套利无法改善风险收益权衡。
AI.research_question: 在美元融资环境下，外汇套利交易的盈利性如何？其风险特征为何？哪些指标可以预示其脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 外汇套利交易是学术界和实务界长期关注的议题，传统研究主要关注其平均收益，但对收益的脆弱性、尾部风险以及事前预警指标的关注不足。本文试图从多个维度（UIP失效、CIP偏差、期权隐含矩、主权债券套利）系统考察外汇套利的风险和回报特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Brunnermeier et al. (2009)的框架，结合未覆盖利率平价（UIP）、覆盖利率平价（CIP）、期权隐含矩（隐含波动率、偏度）以及主权债券套利理论。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用美元融资环境下的外汇套利数据，分析2006年前后表现差异、左尾风险分布、CIP偏差与回报脆弱性的关系、期权隐含矩的事前预测能力，以及主权债券套利的风险收益特征。
AI.findings: （1）外汇套利在美元融资环境下仍有利可图，但2006年后表现减弱且呈强左尾分布；（2）UIP失效解释了平均溢价——高收益货币贬值幅度不足以抵消利率差；（3）CIP偏差揭示了回报脆弱性：雷曼事件后交叉货币基差结构性转负，更大偏差预测未来下行非对称性；（4）期权隐含矩提供了事前证据，表明融资压力和崩盘风险在实现前已被定价；（5）主权债券套利无法改善风险收益权衡，久期和收益率曲线风险补偿不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 在Brunnermeier et al. (2009)的基础上，系统整合了UIP、CIP、期权隐含矩和主权债券套利等多个分析视角，揭示了外汇套利收益背后的脆弱性和尾部风险机制，补充了套利交易崩溃风险的事前预警指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外汇套利投资者提供了风险预警工具（CIP偏差、期权隐含矩），提示2006年后套利策略的收益-风险特征已发生结构性变化，且主权债券套利不是有效的风险分散手段。

reference: Osgoode Legal Studies Research Paper No. 193
title: The ILO Decent Work in the Platform Economy Convention, 2026 (No. 193): A Preliminary Analysis
affiliations: York University - Osgoode Hall Law School

detail.title: The ILO Decent Work in the Platform Economy Convention, 2026 (No. 193): A Preliminary Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: Osgoode Legal Studies Research Paper No. 193
publicationDetails.journalName: Osgoode Hall Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides a preliminary analysis of the ILO Decent Work in the Platform Economy Convention, 2026 (No. 193), the first international labour standard devoted specifically to platform work. It examines the Convention's scope, substantive protections, and principal interpretive questions, arguing that its significance lies in the cumulative architecture through which platform work is brought within the reach of international labour standards. Particular attention is given to the Convention's broad personal scope. Self-employed platform workers are generally included throughout the instrument, while specific provisions permit protections to be adapted to different employment statuses without excluding workers outside an employment relationship. The analysis considers the Convention's provisions on fundamental principles and rights at work, occupational safety and health, violence and harassment, employment-status classification, remuneration, wage protection, social security, and the allocation of responsibility among platforms and intermediaries. This paper also examines the Convention's comparatively novel regulation of algorithmic management. It analyses rights to information concerning automated systems, the connection between their responsible use and collective bargaining, the concept of "decent work by design", written explanations and meaningful human review of automated decisions, personal-data protection, and safeguards concerning suspension, deactivation, and termination. Finally, the paper addresses applicable law, contractual circumvention, forum shopping, and access to remedies. Although the Convention reflects significant compromises, it fully recognises that platform work is work, extends labour protection into areas previously underdeveloped in international labour standards, and provides a binding foundation for national regulation, collective bargaining, litigation, enforcement, and further standard-setting.

AI.tldr: 本文初步分析了《国际劳工组织平台经济体面工作公约》（第193号，2026年），这是首个专门针对平台工作的国际劳工标准，重点考察其范围、实质性保护及主要解释问题。
AI.research_question: 首部专门针对平台工作的国际劳工标准（第193号公约）的适用范围、实质性保护内容及其规范意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 平台经济迅速发展，但缺乏专门的国际劳动标准进行规范，现有劳工标准难以直接适用于平台工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际劳工标准体系、体面工作理论、平台经济劳动治理理论。
AI.method: 规范性文本分析，对公约条款进行逐项解读和解释性分析。
AI.findings: 公约具有广泛的个人适用范围，将自雇平台工作者纳入保护；规定了算法管理的新型监管、体面工作设计理念、数据保护等创新内容；承认平台工作即为工作，为国内立法、集体谈判和诉讼提供约束性基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平台工作正式纳入国际劳工标准体系，拓展了体面工作理论在数字劳动领域的适用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国平台经济劳动立法提供国际法依据，指导算法管理监管、就业身份分类、社会保障等实践问题。

title: When Talk is not Cheap: Communication and Agency Problems in LLM Agents
affiliations: and University of Oxford, Saïd Business School

detail.title: When Talk is not Cheap: Communication and Agency Problems in LLM Agents
detail.abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in fiduciary roles on the premise that software has no private interests. We test this premise with 93 large language models in the trust game of Charness and Dufwenberg (2006) and a financial advising scenario with commission-driven conflicts. LLM agents systematically exploit principals under temptation, with cooperation falling from 58 to 20 percent as conflict intensity rises. Requiring a verbal promise before delegation raises cooperation by 13 to 17 percentage points, driven by independent guilt-aversion and lying-aversion channels. The dispositions are portable: trust-game promise violations predict risky-asset allocations, riskdownplaying, and transaction aggressiveness when advising a risk-averse retiree, with bunching at commission rates that meet sales targets. LLM principals over-trust exploitative counterparts, producing welfare losses that communication redistributes but does not correct. The findings imply that governing multi-agent AI systems requires not only aligning behavior, but also calibrating beliefs about strategically motivated counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过93个大语言模型在信任博弈和金融咨询场景中的实验，发现LLM代理会在利益冲突下系统性地剥削委托人，而承诺机制可以通过内疚规避和说谎规避两个独立渠道提高合作率，但委托人会过度信任剥削性对手，导致福利损失。
AI.research_question: 当AI代理被部署在 fiduciary 角色中时，它们是否真的像"软件没有私人利益"这一前提所假设的那样值得信赖？
AI.motivation: 越来越多AI代理被部署在信托角色中，其假设是软件没有私人利益因而是可信赖的，但这一前提是否成立缺乏系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任博弈理论、内疚规避理论、说谎规避理论、委托代理理论
AI.method: 实验经济学方法：使用93个大语言模型进行Charness and Dufwenberg (2006)的信任博弈实验和金融咨询场景实验，操纵利益冲突强度、承诺机制等变量。
AI.findings: 1) 随着利益冲突强度上升，LLM代理的合作率从58%降至20%；2) 委托前要求口头承诺可使合作率提升13-17个百分点，由内疚规避和说谎规避两个独立渠道驱动；3) 信任博弈中的承诺违规行为可预测高风险资产配置、风险淡化行为和交易激进性；4) LLM委托人过度信任剥削性对手，沟通只能重新分配福利但无法纠正整体福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统检验了"软件没有私人利益"这一AI信托角色部署的前提假设；2) 将行为经济学中的内疚规避和说谎规避理论扩展到LLM代理情境；3) 揭示了多智能体AI系统中信念校准的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 对AI代理的信托部署提出警示，不能默认其可信赖；2) 承诺机制可作为提升AI代理可信度的实用工具；3) 监管多智能体AI系统不仅需对齐行为，还需校准代理对其策略性对手的信念。

title: AI Scribe technology improves efficiency of consultations in Dutch Primary Care: A real-world observational pre-post study
affiliations: Dokter Drenthe, Dokter Drenthe, Dokter Drenthe, University of Groningen, University of Groningen and University of Groningen

detail.title: AI Scribe technology improves efficiency of consultations in Dutch Primary Care: A real-world observational pre-post study
detail.abstract: BackgroundAdministrative burden contributes substantially to workload and burnout in primary care. AI-based voice-to-note tools (“AI scribes”) may reduce documentation time, but real-world evidence in primary care remains limited. We evaluated the impact of a Dutch-language AI scribe on consultation efficiency in routine primary care. MethodsWe conducted a prospective pre–post pilot study between December, 2024, and May, 2025, in 16 general practices in the province of Drenthe, the Netherlands. General practitioners (GPs) and nurse practitioners (NPs) registered 20 consecutive consultations before and after implementation of an AI scribe integrated with their electronic health record system. The primary outcome was the difference in the proportion of consultation time spent on administration (percentage points, 95% CI). Secondary outcomes were total consultation duration (seconds), administrative time (seconds), and number of clinical issues addressed. Linear mixed-effects models accounted for clustering within clinicians and practices. FindingsNineteen clinicians (14 GPs, five NPs) contributed 719 consultations (379 pre-use; 340 during use). The proportion of consultation time spent on administration decreased by 9,1 percentage points (95% CI −10,5 to −7,7). Administrative time decreased by 100 seconds (95% CI −116 to −84), and total consultation time decreased by 114 seconds (95% CI −176 to −53). The number of clinical issues addressed per consultation did not change (mean difference −0,02, 95% CI −0,10 to 0,05). Among GPs, administrative time proportion decreased from 27,8% to 17,4% (absolute difference −10,6 percentage points). Effects were independent of age and typing proficiency. InterpretationIn routine Dutch general practice, AI-supported documentation substantially reduced administrative workload and overall consultation time without reducing consultation content. Context-specific integration and evaluation after implementation may be key determinants of effectiveness. Larger controlled studies are needed to assess long-term sustainability, quality, patient experience, and cost-effectiveness. FundingNo commercial funding. The regional GP organisation facilitated participation through discounted access to the technology.

AI.tldr: 一项在荷兰16家全科诊所开展的前后对照试点研究表明，AI语音转笔记工具（AI scribe）使医生在问诊中的行政事务时间占比降低9.1个百分点，行政时间减少100秒，总问诊时间减少114秒，且不减少处理的临床问题数量。
AI.research_question: 在日常初级保健中，荷兰语AI语音转笔记工具（AI scribe）对问诊效率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 初级保健中行政负担导致工作量大、职业倦怠严重。AI scribe有望减少文档记录时间，但缺乏真实世界初级保健场景的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政负担理论；AI辅助文档记录对工作流程效率的影响机制。
AI.method: 前瞻性前后对照试点研究。2024年12月至2025年5月，荷兰德伦特省16家全科诊所，19名临床医生（14名全科医生、5名执业护士），719次问诊（379次使用前，340次使用中）。主要结局：问诊中行政时间占比差异（百分点，95% CI）。采用线性混合效应模型校正聚类效应。
AI.findings: 行政时间占比降低9.1个百分点（95% CI −10.5至−7.7）；行政时间减少100秒（95% CI −116至−84）；总问诊时间减少114秒（95% CI −176至−53）；处理的临床问题数无显著变化（均差−0.02，95% CI −0.10至0.05）。全科医生行政时间占比从27.8%降至17.4%（绝对差−10.6个百分点）。效果与年龄和打字熟练度无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI辅助文档记录在真实世界初级保健中的效率提升提供了量化证据，验证了AI scribe在不牺牲问诊内容的前提下减少行政负担的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明在常规初级保健中实施AI scribe可显著降低行政工作负荷和问诊时长，且不影响临床问题处理数量；提示情境化整合和落地后评估是有效性的关键因素；为更大规模的长期有效性、质量、患者体验和成本效益研究提供了基础。

title: Come In: Comprehensive Care, Access Frictions, and Social Inclusion
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Bank of Spain and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Come In: Comprehensive Care, Access Frictions, and Social Inclusion
detail.abstract: Even when a national minimum-income scheme formally exists, many eligible households fail to claim it or to benefit fully from it. We study ACCEDE—Spanish for “come in”—a clustered randomized controlled trial implemented by Cáritas across 64 parish clusters in Spain, alongside the national Minimum Income Scheme. Treated parishes opened a dedicated space offering personalized inclusion itineraries, benefit-claiming assistance, job-search and skills support, digital access, group activities, and intensive one-on-one accompaniment. Control parishes continued to provide Cáritas’s standard support. Both arms remained eligible for the same usual cash and in-kind material aid, so the experiment identifies the effect of the access and accompaniment bundle rather than the effect of additional transfers. The program increased average monthly household income, constructed from income received over the previous six months, by about 133 Euros, or 16 percent of the control-group mean. Intermediate outcomes point to several relaxed frictions: job-market engagement increased across employability measures, access to social rights improved, digital skills and connectivity rose, and participation in community groups increased by nearly half a standard deviation. We do not observe a corresponding improvement in regular contact and perceived support, and we cannot decompose the income gain into benefit take-up and earnings.The results nevertheless show that, even when a national income floor formally exists, informational, administrative, digital, and behavioral frictions can materially reduce its effective reach.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项在西班牙64个教区开展的整群随机对照实验，检验了在存在国家最低收入保障计划的情况下，通过提供个性化陪伴与信息获取服务（ACCEDE项目），能否有效提升家庭实际收入。结果表明，该干预使月均家庭收入增加约133欧元（提高16%），中间机制包括促进就业、改善社会权利获取、提升数字技能和社区参与，但未能显著改善社会支持感知。
AI.research_question: 即使存在正式的国家最低收入保障计划，为何许多符合条件的家庭未能申领或充分受益？通过提供信息获取与个性化陪伴服务，能否缓解这些摩擦并提升家庭实际收入？
AI.motivation: 现实中有大量符合条件的低收入家庭未充分受益于现有的国家最低收入保障计划，表明单纯设立"收入底线"并不足以实现政策目标。研究者希望识别和检验信息、行政、数字及行为摩擦对政策有效覆盖的阻碍作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息摩擦、行政摩擦、数字鸿沟与行为经济学中的"摩擦"理论：即使在制度上存在福利资格，获取福利仍面临多重非金钱障碍（如信息不对称、程序复杂性、数字技能缺乏、行为惰性等）。
AI.method: 整群随机对照实验（Clustered RCT），在西班牙64个教区层面随机分组，实验组提供ACCEDE项目（个性化融入路线、福利申领协助、就业与技能支持、数字接入、团体活动、一对一陪伴），对照组提供Cáritas标准支持。两组均保留获取常规现金与实物援助的资格。
AI.findings: （1）干预使月均家庭收入增加约133欧元（较对照组均值提高16%）； （2）就业市场参与度提升； （3）社会权利获取改善； （4）数字技能与网络连接提升；（5）社区团体参与度增加近0.5个标准差； （6）但未观察到常规联系与社会支持感知的相应改善； （7）无法将收入增长分解为福利申领增加与劳动收入增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"福利获取摩擦"理论提供了严格的实验证据，证明即使在正式制度完备的情况下，信息、行政、数字和行为摩擦仍会显著削弱福利政策的实际效果。丰富了关于"嵌入性陪伴"（intensive accompaniment）如何缓解多重福利获取障碍的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和非营利组织提供了可操作的反贫困干预策略：通过在地化的个性化陪伴服务，而非仅增加现金转移，可以显著提升低收入家庭的实际收入和生活质量。启示各国在设计最低收入保障制度时，必须同步配套信息援助、行政协助、数字接入等"软性基础设施"。

title: Distasteful or Repugnant? How Social Context and Money Shape Moral Judgments
affiliations: University of Bologna - Department of Economics,  Universita degli Studi di Torino and Royal Holloway, University of London

detail.title: Distasteful or Repugnant? How Social Context and Money Shape Moral Judgments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study complies with all relevant ethical regulations for research involving human participants. The study protocol was reviewed and approved by the Bioethics Committee at the University of Bologna under protocol number 0048299. The informed consent provided by participants is available on our OSF page, https://osf.io/2crf5/?view_only=03fa73355400404e82aeaa58981213e3 (see the folder “Qualtrics Survey”). Participants were recruited through the BLESS – Bologna Laboratory for Experiments in Social Sciences. No identifiable private data was collected during the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Repugnance toward market transactions is often attributed to the nature of the goods exchanged. We study whether moral judgments are also shaped by contextual features-social proximity and the means of exchange. In a 2×2 between-subject experiment, participants evaluated ethically contentious transactions under family versus stranger and monetary versus non-monetary conditions, reporting personal and social norms on a four-point scale-"Normal," "Tolerable," "Distasteful," "Repugnant." We find that family ties had a stronger effect than monetary exchange. While money mainly shaped social acceptability, family involvement affected both norms. We also document heterogeneity across domains and context-dependent norm alignment.

AI.tldr: 通过2×2实验发现，社会距离（家庭vs陌生人）比交换媒介（货币vs非货币）对道德判断的影响更大，且家庭关系同时影响个人规范和社会规范，而货币主要影响社会可接受性。
AI.research_question: 道德判断是否不仅受交换物品性质的影响，还受社会距离和交换媒介等情境因素的塑造？
AI.motivation: 以往研究将市场交易的厌恶感主要归因于交换物品本身的性质，忽视了社会距离和交换媒介等情境因素的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德判断的社会情境理论；个人规范与社会规范的区分；社会距离与交换媒介对道德评价的影响。
AI.method: 2×2被试间实验设计，操纵社会距离（家庭vs陌生人）和交换媒介（货币vs非货币），让被试在4分量表上报告个人规范和社会规范。
AI.findings: 家庭关系对道德判断的影响强于货币交换；货币主要塑造社会可接受性，而家庭关系同时影响个人规范和社会规范；不同道德领域存在异质性，且情境依赖的规范一致性效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将市场厌恶感仅归因于交换物品性质的传统观点，揭示了社会距离和交换媒介的情境塑造作用，并区分了个人规范与社会规范的差异影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解市场交易中的道德判断提供更精细的分析框架，有助于设计更符合公众道德感知的经济制度与政策。

title: Playing the Price: Informed Trading, Price Impact and Trade Splitting in Derivatives Markets

detail.title: Playing the Price: Informed Trading, Price Impact and Trade Splitting in Derivatives Markets
detail.abstract: This paper develops a simple game-theoretic model of informed trading, price impact, and trade splitting in derivatives markets. The model studies an informed trader who has a private valuation of a derivative contract and a market maker who adjusts execution prices in response to order size. In a one-period setting with linear price impact, the informed trader chooses an order quantity by balancing the value of an information edge against the cost of moving the price. The resulting optimal order size is increasing in the information edge and decreasing in the price-impact coefficient, while the equilibrium execution price lies halfway between the market maker's public-information valuation and the informed trader's private valuation. The paper then extends the model to a multi-period setting in which the informed trader splits trades across several rounds. Under linear permanent price impact, the optimal symmetric strategy is to trade equal quantities in each period. Total expected profit increases with the number of trading periods but converges to a finite upper bound, implying diminishing marginal gains from additional trade splitting. The framework provides a compact pedagogical link between adverse selection, market depth, and optimal execution in derivatives markets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个博弈论模型，研究衍生品市场中知情交易者的订单拆分、价格冲击与最优执行策略。核心发现包括：单期均衡执行价格介于市场做市商公开估值与知情交易者私有估值之间；多期最优策略为每期等量交易，总期望利润随交易期数增加但收敛于有限上界。
AI.research_question: 在衍生品市场中，知情交易者如何通过订单拆分来平衡信息优势与价格冲击成本，以实现最优执行策略？
AI.motivation: 衍生品市场中的交易执行问题涉及信息不对称与价格冲击，现有文献对知情交易者最优订单拆分策略的博弈论分析尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（知情交易者与做市商的两方博弈）、线性价格冲击模型、多期动态决策模型。
AI.method: 博弈论建模与数学推导。单期模型求解最优订单规模，多期模型求解对称均衡下的最优交易序列。
AI.findings: (1) 单期最优订单规模随信息优势递增、随价格冲击系数递减；(2) 均衡执行价格位于做市商公开估值与知情交易者私有估值的中点；(3) 多期最优对称策略为每期等量交易；(4) 总期望利润随交易期数增加，但收敛于有限上界，表明拆分交易的边际收益递减。
AI.theory_contributions: 为衍生品市场中的知情交易与价格冲击提供了简洁的博弈论分析框架，建立了逆向选择、市场深度与最优执行三者之间的教学联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为衍生品市场参与者（如机构交易者）提供了关于订单拆分策略的量化指导，说明了多期拆分虽有收益但边际效用递减。

title: Funding Rates and the Conditional Informativeness of Order Flow: Evidence from the Binance XAUUSDT Gold Perpetual

detail.title: Funding Rates and the Conditional Informativeness of Order Flow: Evidence from the Binance XAUUSDT Gold Perpetual

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study uses publicly available market data and does not involve human participants, personal data, patients, animals, or clinical material.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: One of the key institutions in a perpetual futures contract is the funding-rate mechanism, yet its role in information processing remains largely unexplored. This paper examines the question using the Binance XAUUSDT gold perpetual, a commodity-linked cryptocurrency perpetual introduced in January 2026, and 203,037 one-minute observations from its early trading period. In this benchmark-anchored instrument, whose reference value is discovered off-exchange, the order-flow proxies used in the paper have no unconditional predictive ability: trade-based order-flow imbalance is insignificant in-sample, produces negative outof-sample predictive R-squared, and fails to survive multiple-testing corrections. The active channel is instead the funding mechanism. The funding rate positively predicts returns at five-, fifteen-, and thirty-minute horizons (t = 2.22, 2.95, 3.71), while the funding-by-orderflow interaction is negative and significant at all three horizons (t =-2.64,-2.28,-2.26). The positive funding coefficient captures the persistence and directional component of leveragedriven demand, whereas the negative interaction captures the marginal reversal effect of additional buying pressure when positioning is already crowded. Session-level patterns around the European window are stable in sign but do not survive multiple-testing correction, alternative window definitions, alternative normalisations, or non-overlapping sampling schemes; event-study and placebo evidence do not isolate the London afternoon fix as the source of the pattern. The effects are small and not profitable once trading costs are considered. The evidence points to a funding-based positioning-and-reversal channel rather than a classical informed-trading channel in commodity-linked perpetuals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究永续合约中的资金费率机制在信息处理中的作用。以Binance XAUUSDT黄金永续合约为对象，使用203,037个一分钟观测数据发现：传统订单流无预测能力，而资金费率能正向预测5-30分钟回报，资金费率与订单流的交互项则负向显著，体现了拥挤头寸下的反转效应。证据支持基于资金费率的头寸-反转通道，而非经典的信息交易通道。
AI.research_question: 在商品挂钩的加密货币永续合约中，资金费率机制是否以及如何发挥信息处理作用？
AI.motivation: 永续合约的资金费率机制是核心制度设计，但其在信息处理中的角色尚未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息交易理论、头寸与反转理论、资金费率机制的信息传递功能
AI.method: 使用Binance XAUUSDT黄金永续合约的203,037个一分钟高频观测数据，进行样本内回归、样本外预测R平方、多重检验校正、事件研究、安慰剂检验等。
AI.findings: （1）订单流不平衡无预测能力；（2）资金费率正向预测5/15/30分钟回报；（3）资金费率与订单流交互项负向显著；（4）欧洲窗口时段模式不稳定，无法通过多重检验校正；（5）考虑交易成本后无盈利空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示永续合约中存在资金费率驱动的头寸-反转通道，而非传统信息交易通道，拓展了市场微观结构与加密资产定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对交易者而言，资金费率的预测信号在扣除成本后无实质盈利价值；对交易所和监管机构而言，需关注资金费率机制可能引发的拥挤与反转风险。

title: Beyond Manufacturing Excellence: Global Pharmacovigilance Challenges Facing Indian Biosimilar Manufacturers in Regulated Markets

detail.title: Beyond Manufacturing Excellence: Global Pharmacovigilance Challenges Facing Indian Biosimilar Manufacturers in Regulated Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of three independent ventures, declared in the interest of full transparency: MyCliniLedger and MyMediLedger are health-technology platforms (an electronic medical record system and a patient personal health-record platform, respectively); MedClariva is a separate, independent medical consulting practice. None of these ventures funded this review, and the analysis presents publicly available information without commercial endorsement.
declarations.funderStatement: This review received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background. India has become a leading global supplier of affordable biologics, supported by large manufacturing capacity, cost competitiveness and a maturing scientific base. Yet domestic approval success does not translate automatically into sustained competitiveness in highly regulated markets, where post-marketing safety surveillance has become a central determinant of market access. 

Objective. This narrative review examines the pharmacovigilance (PV) challenges facing Indian biosimilar manufacturers as they expand into regulated markets, and considers how evolving regulatory expectations, real-world evidence (RWE) generation and artificial intelligence (AI) are reshaping the competitive landscape. 

Key challenges. Regulatory fragmentation, product-specific risk management plan (RMP) complexity, persistent traceability gaps at the batch level, long-horizon immunogenicity monitoring, cross-market signal detection, a deficit of multinational RWE, inspection readiness and a shortage of specialised PV expertise are identified as the principal barriers, with India-specific evidence on under-reporting and biologics surveillance presented to contextualise them. 

Future directions. A structured response is proposed through the GLOBAL-PV framework, anchored to specific regulatory instruments, alongside a discussion of AI-assisted case processing and its validation and governance requirements, and of patient-centric and ethical considerations. Recent regulatory developments including the United States Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) move to streamline biosimilar approval and converge biosimilarity with interchangeability are examined for their strategic implications. 

Conclusion. As analytical and manufacturing barriers narrow, pharmacovigilance excellence is emerging as the decisive differentiator. Indian manufacturers that embed robust safety surveillance, RWE generation, advanced signal detection and validated AI-enabled monitoring into their lifecycle strategy will be best positioned to lead in regulated international markets.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了印度生物类似药生产商在进入国际监管市场时面临的药物警戒挑战，提出了GLOBAL-PV框架，并指出药物警戒卓越能力正成为全球市场竞争的关键差异化因素。
AI.research_question: 印度生物类似药制造商在向监管严格的市场扩张过程中，面临哪些药物警戒挑战？以及不断变化的监管期望、真实世界证据生成和人工智能如何重塑竞争格局？
AI.motivation: 印度已成为全球可负担生物类似药的主要供应国，但国内审批成功并不能自动转化为在高度监管市场中的持续竞争力，而上市后安全监测已成为市场准入的核心决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: GLOBAL-PV框架，整合药物警戒理论、真实世界证据生成、人工智能辅助案例处理、患者中心与伦理考量。
AI.method: 叙事综述（Narrative Review）
AI.findings: 识别出八大主要障碍：监管碎片化、产品-specific风险管理计划复杂性、批次层面可追溯性缺口、长期免疫原性监测、跨市场信号检测、跨国真实世界证据不足、检查准备度不足、PV专业人才短缺。印度特有的低报告率和生物制品监测数据进一步凸显了这些问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出GLOBAL-PV结构化框架，为印度生物类似药制造商提供了应对药物警戒挑战的系统性理论路径；讨论了AI辅助案例处理的验证与治理要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度生物类似药制造商提供了具体的战略建议：通过嵌入稳健的安全监测、真实世界证据生成、先进信号检测和经过验证的AI赋能源监测来提升国际监管市场竞争力；分析了FDA简化生物类似药审批和融合可互换性的监管动态的战略含义。

title: On the Failure of Representative-Agent Approximations

detail.title: On the Failure of Representative-Agent Approximations
detail.abstract: Representative-agent models are widely used as tractable approximations to heterogeneous economies. While classical aggregation theory identifies restrictive conditions under which heterogeneous agents can be represented exactly by a single agent, modern macroeconomic analysis often relies on a weaker claim: that representative-agent formulations provide useful local approximations to aggregate behavior. This paper examines that claim directly. We derive a general aggregation theorem showing that aggregation and differentiation do not generally commute. When individual decision rules are nonlinear in heterogeneous characteristics, the aggregate marginal response differs from the marginal response evaluated at average characteristics. The discrepancy is characterized by a covariance correction term involving the distribution of heterogeneous states and the curvature of the marginal response function. Consequently, representative-agent approximations fail generically whenever heterogeneity interacts with nonlinear marginal responses. The result identifies two knife-edge cases in which representative-agent approximations remain locally exact: homogeneous populations and locally linear marginal responses. Outside these special environments, aggregate comparative statics depend on distributional characteristics that cannot be recovered from average conditions alone. The theorem applies broadly to consumption, investment, expectations formation, labor supply, and other economic environments involving heterogeneous agents. The paper contributes to the aggregation literature by distinguishing the problem of aggregating marginal responses from the classical problem of aggregating levels. More generally, it identifies a class of environments in which heterogeneity remains aggregation-relevant and aggregate behavior depends directly on the distribution of underlying characteristics. The results imply that representative-agent models impose substantive restrictions on aggregate responses rather than serving as purely technical simplifications. More broadly, the theorem provides a general aggregation mechanism through which heterogeneity in decision architectures can influence aggregate outcomes, thereby contributing to the emerging literature on Hetero Behaviorus economies.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个一般性加总定理：加总与微分通常不可交换。当个体决策规则在异质性特征上非线性时，总边际响应与在平均特征处评估的边际响应存在差异，差异由协方差修正项刻画。代表性主体近似仅在两种边界情况下局部精确：同质总体或局部线性边际响应。异质性在更一般的环境中是"加总相关的"。
AI.research_question: 代表性主体模型是否能为异质性经济体的总体行为提供有用的局部近似？加总与微分在什么条件下可交换？
AI.motivation: 经典加总理论已知代表性主体模型在强约束下才精确成立，但现代宏观分析常依赖"代表性主体提供有用局部近似"的较弱主张。本文直接检验这一主张，从边际响应的加总角度切入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般性加总定理：加总算子与微分算子不可交换(d/dθ∫≠∫d/dθ)。当个体决策规则非线性时，总边际响应=平均特征处边际响应+协方差修正项(异质性状态分布×边际响应函数曲率)。两种边界情况：同质总体或线性边际响应。
AI.method: 理论推导与数学证明。从加总与微分交换性的数学条件出发，推导协方差修正项，识别边界情况，并讨论对消费、投资、预期形成、劳动供给等领域的含义。
AI.findings: (1)加总与微分一般不交换；(2)代表性主体近似的误差由异质性分布与边际响应曲率的协方差刻画；(3)仅在同质总体或线性边际响应两种边界情况下局部精确；(4)总体比较静态分析依赖分布特征，无法从平均条件恢复；(5)该定理广泛适用于消费、投资、预期形成、劳动供给等经济环境。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)将边际响应的加总问题与经典的水平加总问题区分开来；(2)识别了异质性保持"加总相关"的环境类别；(3)证明了代表性主体模型施加了实质性限制而非纯粹技术简化；(4)揭示了异质性通过决策架构影响总体结果的一般加总机制，为Hetero Behaviorus经济学做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 对宏观经济学研究和政策分析具有警示意义：使用代表性主体模型进行政策评估（如比较静态分析）时，若存在异质性和非线性边际响应，结论可能产生系统性偏差。政策制定者应关注分布特征而非仅关注平均条件。

title: The Minimal Agency Condition: A Precondition for Welfare Evaluation

detail.title: The Minimal Agency Condition: A Precondition for Welfare Evaluation
detail.abstract: This paper argues that normative welfare economics presupposes a Minimal Agency Condition (MAC). Although preference-based and opportunity-based approaches disagree regarding the appropriate metric of welfare, both rely upon the assumption that individuals possess sufficient practical agency for preferences or opportunities to function as meaningful indicators of well-being. I argue that this presupposition has received insufficient explicit attention. The paper develops the concept of survival-dominant compression, whereby severe deprivation may systematically narrow practical agency through the dominance of immediate stabilization pressures. Under such conditions, preferences and opportunities may remain observable while their connection to welfare becomes increasingly unstable. The resulting problem is not merely one of imperfect information or behavioral distortion. Rather, welfare metrics themselves may lose the interpretive authority required to support normative welfare claims. MAC identifies the minimal level of practical agency necessary for welfare metrics to function as normatively interpretable indicators of well-being. The argument differs from capability theories, adaptive preference critiques, and behavioral welfare economics by focusing not on the content of welfare or preferences, but on the applicability conditions of welfare metrics themselves. The paper concludes that the traditional preference-opportunity debate is methodologically incomplete unless the practical conditions required for welfare interpretation are explicitly specified. MAC is proposed as one such condition. This manuscript is the first in a planned research program developing the Minimal Agency Condition (MAC) and exploring its implications for welfare economics, behavioral welfare theory, contractarian justification, responsibility attribution, market legitimacy, and democratic theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出规范福利经济学预设了“最小能动条件”（MAC），即个体需具备足够的实践能动性，才能使偏好或机会成为有意义的福祉指标。在严重匮乏（生存主导压缩）条件下，偏好和机会可能可观察，但其与福祉的关联不再稳定，导致福利度量丧失解释权威。MAC是福利度量可被规范性解释的前提条件。
AI.research_question: 规范福利经济学中，福利度量（偏好、机会）在何种条件下才具有规范性解释权威？个体实践能动性不足时，传统福利指标是否仍能支持规范性福利主张？
AI.motivation: 偏好与机会两种福利路径都预设了个体具备足够的实践能动性，但这一预设未得到充分关注。在极端贫困或压迫条件下，个体可能失去将偏好/机会与福祉相连接的能力，导致福利度量本身失效——而不仅仅是信息不完美或偏好扭曲的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最小能动条件（MAC）；生存主导压缩（survival-dominant compression）；福利度量的规范性解释条件；区分于能力理论、适应性偏好批判和行为福利经济学。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论论证，通过发展“生存主导压缩”和“最小能动条件”两个核心概念，对既有福利经济学的前提预设进行批判性检视。
AI.findings: 1. 偏好和机会作为福利指标仅当个体具备足够实践能动性时才具有规范性权威；2. 严重匮乏可导致“生存主导压缩”，系统性地窄化实践能动性；3. 此时福利度量虽可观察，但丧失了连接福祉的规范性解释权威；4. 传统偏好-机会之争在未明确福利解释的实践条件前在方法论上是不完整的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出最小能动条件（MAC）作为福利度量的适用性条件，将讨论焦点从福利内容转向福利度量的前提条件，弥补了传统偏好-机会辩论忽视能动性预设的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 对极端贫困评估、福利政策设计、发展经济学中的福祉测量具有方法论警示意义：在严重匮乏条件下，需审慎使用偏好和机会作为福利指标，否则可能导致规范性误判。

title: Capital-Level Factor Neutrality with Projected Partial Rebalancing

detail.title: Capital-Level Factor Neutrality with Projected Partial Rebalancing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, patients, animals, or personally identifiable private data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper studies a portfolio-construction method that imposes factor neutrality directly on implemented capital weights, rather than only residualising the alpha signal before optimisation. At each rebalance, portfolios are represented in coordinates inside the monitored neutral subspace, making the final traded portfolio factor-neutral by construction. The method is equivalent to equality-constrained Markowitz optimisation and gives finite-sample leakage bounds when exposure definitions differ.

The construction is extended to projected partial rebalancing, where the previous holding is first projected into the current neutral subspace and then moved part way toward the full neutral target. Walk-forward tests across six research universes show numerical-level exposure leakage for neutral-coordinate portfolios and lower turnover for projected partial variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种直接在资本权重上施加因子中性的投资组合构建方法，并通过投影部分再平衡扩展，在六个研究领域中验证了其暴露泄漏的数值级降低和更低换手率。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种直接在资本权重上实现因子中性，而非仅对alpha信号进行残差化的投资组合方法？
AI.motivation: 传统方法仅对alpha信号进行残差化处理，未能直接在组合权重层面控制因子暴露，导致实际交易组合可能存在因子泄露问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子中性投资组合构建、等式约束Markowitz优化、投影部分再平衡。
AI.method: 将组合表示为受监控中性子空间内的坐标，使交易组合结构上因子中性；扩展为投影部分再平衡，将前一期持仓投影到当前中性子空间后部分移动至完全中性目标。在六个研究领域进行walk-forward回测。
AI.findings: 中性坐标组合在暴露泄漏上达到数值级水平；投影部分再平衡变体降低了换手率。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了该构造等价于等式约束Markowitz优化，并给出了当暴露定义不同时有限样本泄漏的理论界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可直接用于实际交易的因子中性组合构建方法，并通过投影部分再平衡有效控制了交易成本。
