title: Preventable Maternal Mortality in Afghanistan: Trends, Lessons and Recommendations
affiliations: University of London - St. George's, Shahid Beheshti University of Medical Sciences, , University of Toronto  and University of Toronto - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Preventable Maternal Mortality in Afghanistan: Trends, Lessons and Recommendations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors did not receive funding for this paper.

keywords: Convention on the Elimination of all Forms of Discrimination against Women

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Gynecology & Obstetrics, volume 173, issue 3, 2026[10.1002/ijgo.71049]

detail.abstract:
Afghan women’s and girls’ lack of access to education and health services and denial of their freedom of movement threaten to increase maternal mortality thus denying them their human rights. 

This article synthesizes recent peer-reviewed studies and institutional reports on maternal mortality following the Taliban’s return to power in Afghanistan in August 2021 and compares emerging patterns with the first Taliban period (1996–2001), when maternal mortality reached some of the highest levels recorded in conflict settings.

Multiple data sources indicate worsening conditions after 2021, including sharp reductions in service utilization following funding interruptions, reported declines in access to antenatal and intrapartum care, and clinician-reported increases in delays and life-threatening obstetric complications. Modelling based on routine health data suggests that sustained reductions in coverage could result in thousands of additional maternal deaths annually.

The acute difference between Afghanistan especially since 2021 and many other fragile settings is that gender-based restrictions specifically target women’s and girls’ education, employment, and movement, directly affecting demand-side access and supply-side staffing capacity for maternal care, thus offending Afghanistan’s obligations under the Convention on the Elimination of All forms of Discrimination against Women.

AI.tldr: 本文综合分析了塔利班2021年重新掌权后阿富汗孕产妇死亡率的变化，发现性别限制政策导致孕产妇保健服务利用急剧下降，可能每年导致数千例额外孕产妇死亡，并违反了《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》。
AI.research_question: 塔利班2021年重新掌权后，阿富汗孕产妇死亡率如何变化？性别限制政策对孕产妇健康的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 塔利班重新掌权后实施的性别限制政策（限制女性教育、就业和行动自由）可能对孕产妇健康产生严重负面影响，需要系统评估这种影响以引起国际关注并促进政策干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人权框架（基于《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》）；性别不平等与健康结果的关系理论；冲突环境下的健康服务可及性理论。
AI.method: 综合综述：汇集近期同行评审研究和机构报告，比较2021年后与塔利班第一时期（1996-2001）的孕产妇死亡率模式。
AI.findings: 2021年后条件恶化：服务利用率大幅下降；产前和分娩护理可及性下降；临床医生报告并发症和延误增加；模型预测持续覆盖率下降可能导致每年数千例额外孕产妇死亡。与其它脆弱环境的关键区别在于，阿富汗的性别限制政策直接针对女性教育、就业和行动，同时影响需求侧（女性就医）和供给侧（女性医护人员）能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了性别限制政策作为孕产妇健康的结构性决定因素，区别于一般冲突环境下的健康影响机制，丰富了性别不平等与健康结果的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会提供证据，证明阿富汗水塔利班性别限制政策对孕产妇健康的严重危害及其对国际人权公约的违反，呼吁采取紧急干预措施。

title: Did Federal Broadband Stimulus Improve Rural Health? A Comprehensive Bounding Analysis of Rejected ARRA Applicants

detail.title: Did Federal Broadband Stimulus Improve Rural Health? A Comprehensive Bounding Analysis of Rejected ARRA Applicants

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Federal broadband programs are promoted partly on rural-health grounds, yet credibly identified evidence on whether broadband improves rural health is scarce, and the $42 billion BEAD program makes the question pressing. This study estimates the short-run association between the 2009 federal broadband stimulus (the USDA Broadband Initiatives Program and the NTIA Broadband Technology Opportunities Program) and a battery of rural health and socioeconomic outcomes. A rejected-applicant differencein-differences design compares 2,448 funded counties to 263 trajectory-matched rejected applicants, contrasting the pre-award (2010-2013) and pre-COVID post-award (2018-2019) periods. I estimate effects on nineteen County Health Rankings outcomes spanning healthcare access, screening, health behaviors, mortality, mental health, and socioeconomic status, with cluster-robust, randomization-inference, family-wise falsediscovery-rate, and state-by-year fixed-effects checks. The award raised fiber availability by 2.8 percentage points relative to rejected applicants, yet I find no robust effect on any of the nineteen outcomes. The two conventionally significant baseline estimates (preventable hospitalizations and high-school graduation) are absorbed by state-byyear fixed effects, consistent with state-level confounding, though that specification may also absorb state-level treatment variation; child poverty survives that test but not a multiple-testing correction, and the rest are precise nulls with reported minimum detectable effects. The stimulus raised fiber availability only modestly, and that expansion produced no detectable short-run improvements in rural health or socioeconomic outcomes. The estimates bound the short-run health returns to a 2.8-percentage-point fiber increase below policy-relevant magnitudes, an input to the cost-benefit case for the far larger BEAD program.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2009年美国联邦宽带刺激计划（USDA BIP和NTIA BTOP）的申请被拒者作为对照组，采用轨迹匹配的双重差分法，评估了宽带扩张对农村地区19项健康与社会经济指标的影响。研究发现，虽然刺激计划使光纤覆盖率提高了2.8个百分点，但对任何一项结果指标均未产生稳健的改善效应。
AI.research_question: 联邦宽带刺激计划是否改善了农村居民的健康和社会经济状况？
AI.motivation: 联邦宽带计划在政策辩论中常以改善农村健康为理由，但缺乏因果识别的经验证据。鉴于BEAD项目拨款高达420亿美元，评估此前宽带刺激计划的健康回报对于成本效益分析具有紧迫的现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宽带基础设施→医疗服务可及性与健康行为→健康结果；宽带→社会经济机会→健康的社会决定因素。
AI.method: 采用拒绝-申请者双重差分设计（rejected-applicant difference-in-differences），将2448个获得资助的县与263个经过轨迹匹配的申请被拒县进行比较，对比资助前（2010-2013年）与新冠前的资助后时期（2018-2019年）。分析涵盖19项县级健康排名指标，并进行了聚类稳健标准误、随机化推断、族系错误发现率校正以及州×年固定效应等稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 刺激计划使光纤覆盖率提升2.8个百分点，但未对19项结果指标中的任何一项产生稳健效应。两个常规显著的基线估计（可预防住院和高中毕业率）在加入州×年固定效应后被吸收；儿童贫困率虽通过该检验但未通过多重检验校正；其余指标均为精确零结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"宽带促进农村健康"这一论断提供了严谨的因果证据，表明短期内的适度宽带扩张可能不足以产生可检测的健康改善，对基础设施与健康结果之间的理论关系提供了边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为BEAD等大规模宽带投资项目的成本效益分析提供了关键的短期健康回报估算上限，提示政策制定者不宜对宽带项目的即期健康收益抱有过高预期。

title: Distress, Not Just Drugs: NAFTA, Suicide, and the Geography of the Opioid Epidemic

detail.title: Distress, Not Just Drugs: NAFTA, Suicide, and the Geography of the Opioid Epidemic

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: How do trade shocks raise mortality, and through which causes of death? Using restricted, county-identified CDC Multiple Cause of Death microdata for 1990 to 2024 and the Hakobyan and McLaren county tariff shift-share, I find that the mortality response to NAFTA runs through suicide rather than through the drug overdoses of the contemporaneous opioid epidemic. A one-standard-deviation increase in exposure raises the age-adjusted suicide rate by 0.30 to 0.53 per 100,000. The estimate holds under a China-shock control, division-by-year fixed effects, commuting-zone trends, and spatial-HAC inference, though it is marginal under the most demanding shockpermutation test. Drug overdose shows no robust positive response: it is imprecise, halved by within-state fixed effects, and negative in the fentanyl era. The suicide response survives excluding every drug-related death and is carried by firearm suicide, which rises even where prescription opioids were scarce, both in the states whose pre-1996 triplicate-prescription programs held down OxyContin and across the county distribution of opioid shipments. Firearm suicide is therefore not the opioid epidemic completed by a firearm. The response is borne by men and concentrated among non-Hispanic whites, and a labor-market first stage confirms that exposure depressed local employment and income. Because the scar persists and no later trade-policy episode reverses it, the policy margin is local labor markets and mental-health infrastructure, not the trade barrier itself.

AI.tldr: NAFTA关税冲击通过提高自杀率（尤其是枪支自杀）而非药物过量导致死亡率上升，且这一影响持续存在，无法通过后续贸易政策逆转。
AI.research_question: 贸易冲击如何导致死亡率上升？通过哪些死因渠道？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注贸易冲击对经济的影响，但对死亡率及具体死因的传导机制缺乏细致分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易冲击→劳动力市场恶化（就业和收入下降）→心理健康恶化→自杀率上升（特别是枪支自杀）。
AI.method: 使用CDC 1990-2024年县级死亡率微观数据，结合Hakobyan和McLaren的县级关税shift-share工具变量，进行固定效应回归、空间HAC推断、冲击排列检验等。
AI.findings: 关税冲击使年龄调整后的自杀率每10万人增加0.30-0.53人；自杀反应主要由枪支自杀驱动，且独立于阿片类药物流行；药物过量无稳健正向反应；影响集中在男性和非西班牙裔白人。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了贸易冲击影响死亡率的两种渠道（自杀 vs. 药物过量），揭示了枪支自杀作为独立机制而非阿片类药物流行的衍生结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策应聚焦于地方劳动力市场和心理健康基础设施，而非贸易壁垒本身；贸易冲击造成的伤害具有持久性，后续贸易政策无法逆转。

title: A Fast Implied Volatility Method with Expansions
affiliations: and Central Bank of the UAE

detail.title: A Fast Implied Volatility Method with Expansions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authored study does not reflect any views and/or opinions of European Investment Bank and Central Bank of UAE.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding is received.

detail.abstract: We present a regime-split Black-Scholes implied volatility solver in which every initial seed is a fully closed-form analytical expression, derived from the asymptotic structure of the Black-Scholes price in its natural domain. At the money, series reversion of an exact Gaussian identity yields a fourth-order seed with error O(s 8). In the moderate out-of-the-money region, successive Gaussian CDF approximations of increasing order produce explicit initial seed formulas whose accuracy is proved numerically, with no iteration or numerical inversion at the seed stage. In the deep out-of-the-money region, a Gaussian tail cancellation identity-the Mills ratio-reveals the asymptotic structure of the Black-Scholes price and motivates a ratio-corrected seed that achieves near-machine-precision initialisation for large moneyness. All regime boundaries are derived analytically from CDF truncation tolerances and numerical solver theoretical error bounds, with no empirically tuned constants. A universal fourth-order Householder polisher then drives all regimes to machine precision, with mean update iterations strictly below two on both standard and granular benchmark grids-meeting and surpassing the two-iteration target established by the highest-accuracy reference implementations in the literature. The resulting C implementation achieves a 1.73-1.78× throughput gain over the state-of-the-art benchmark under identical hardware and compiler conditions, with maximum absolute error O(10-14), stable across grid configurations. A Python/Numba implementation confirms portability. All source code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于解析初值的分段Black-Scholes隐含波动率求解器，在不同区域（平价、中虚值、深虚值）分别使用闭式解析种子，结合四阶Householder抛光器，实现平均迭代少于2次、最大绝对误差O(10⁻¹⁴)，并在C实现中比现有最优方法快1.73-1.78倍。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个高效、精确且无需经验调参的Black-Scholes隐含波动率求解算法？
AI.motivation: 隐含波动率是金融衍生品定价和风险管理中的核心指标，现有数值求解器在精度、速度和稳定性之间存在权衡，且许多方法依赖经验调参或需要多次迭代。
AI.theoretical_framework: Black-Scholes定价模型、Mills比率（高斯尾消恒等式）、高斯CDF渐近展开、级数反演、四阶Householder迭代法。
AI.method: 将货币性（moneyness）分为三个区域：平价区使用级数反演得到四阶解析种子；中虚值区使用高斯CDF渐近展开得到递增阶数的显式种子公式；深虚值区使用Mills比率构造比率校正种子。根据CDF截断容差和数值求解器理论误差界推导区域边界（无经验参数）。统一使用四阶Householder迭代法抛光至机器精度。
AI.findings: 所有区域平均迭代次数严格低于2次；C实现比现有最优方法快1.73-1.78倍；最大绝对误差O(10⁻¹⁴)；在标准网格和精细网格上均稳定；Python/Numba实现验证了可移植性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Mills比率引入隐含波动率初始种子构造；推导了无经验参数的区域边界公式；证明了平价区四阶种子误差阶数为O(s⁸)。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供完全开源的高精度、高性能隐含波动率求解器；C实现显著超越现有文献最高基准两迭代目标；Python实现展示便捷的跨语言可移植性。

title: Seven Structural Threats Reshaping the Insurance Industry: Insurability, the Customer Relationship, and the Balance Sheet

detail.title: Seven Structural Threats Reshaping the Insurance Industry: Insurability, the Customer Relationship, and the Balance Sheet
detail.abstract: The global insurance industry is being reshaped by a convergence of structural pressures that, taken together, alter the fundamentals of the business: what insurers can price, who owns the customer relationship, and who owns the risk capital that backs policies. This paper offers an analytical review of seven contemporary threats and organizes them into three categories. Threats to insurability-climate risk and home affordability are compressing the set of risks that private markets can profitably underwrite. Threats to the customer relationship-the erosion of consumer trust, the entry of original-equipment manufacturers (OEMs) into auto insurance, and artificial intelligence are contesting who intermediates between insurer and insured. Threats to the balance sheet-private-equity consolidation of life insurers and a tightening regulatory environment are changing who holds and governs insurance capital. Drawing on peer-reviewed research and authoritative 2024-2026 industry and regulatory data, the paper argues that these threats are interdependent rather than isolated, and that the industry's response to any one of them is constrained by the others. It identifies the mechanisms linking the seven threats and outlines implications for insurers, regulators, and policyholders.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了重塑全球保险业的七种结构性威胁（气候风险与住房可负担性威胁可保性、消费者信任流失/OEM进入/人工智能威胁客户关系、私募股权整合与监管收紧威胁资产负债表），指出这些威胁相互依存而非孤立，并探讨了对保险公司、监管机构和保单持有人的影响。
AI.research_question: 全球保险业面临的七种结构性威胁是什么？这些威胁如何相互关联并改变保险业的定价、客户关系及风险资本所有权等基本面？
AI.motivation: 保险业正面临多重结构性压力的汇聚，这些压力从根本上改变了保险业务的基础逻辑，但现有研究往往分别讨论这些威胁，缺乏对它们之间相互依存关系的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威胁分类框架（可保性威胁、客户关系威胁、资产负债表威胁）及威胁间相互依存机制分析。
AI.method: 基于同行评审研究及2024-2026年行业与监管权威数据的分析性综述。
AI.findings: 七种威胁分为三类：气候风险与住房可负担性压缩可保范围；消费者信任流失、OEM进入车险和人工智能争夺保险中介角色；私募股权整合寿险与监管收紧改变资本持有与治理结构。这些威胁相互依存，单一威胁的应对受其他威胁约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统的威胁分类框架，并揭示了七种威胁之间的相互依存机制，弥补了以往孤立分析各威胁的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司、监管机构和保单持有人提供了理解行业系统性变革的整合视角，有助于制定更具全局观的应对策略。

title: Hetero Behaviorus Dynamics

detail.title: Hetero Behaviorus Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes how heterogeneous behavioral architectures can affect aggregate economic dynamics. Standard dynamic models typically characterize stability, trajectories, and long-run behavior using economic fundamentals such as preferences, technologies, endowments, and policy rules. In representativeagent settings, differences in expectation formation, information processing, learning, forecasting, attention, and inference are either abstracted away or treated as dynamically irrelevant. This paper examines the consequences of allowing the distribution of behavioral architectures to enter the aggregate state description. The analysis introduces behavioral composition as a potential state variable and studies dynamic systems in which aggregate outcomes depend jointly on economic conditions and the distribution of behavioral architectures. The central result is a Behavioral Stability Theorem. The theorem establishes that behavioral composition may alter the local stability properties of an economy even when underlying economic fundamentals remain unchanged. Consequently, two economies with identical preferences, technologies, endowments, policy rules, and structural parameters may exhibit different dynamic behavior solely because they possess different distributions of behavioral architectures. Several implications follow. Behavioral composition may alter aggregate trajectories despite identical fundamentals, generate bifurcations without changes in structural parameters, and create path dependence through the evolution of behavioral distributions. These results imply that behavioral heterogeneity may influence not only aggregate outcomes but also the dynamic structure through which those outcomes evolve. The paper therefore identifies conditions under which distributions of behavioral architectures constitute economically meaningful state variables rather than merely descriptive characteristics of a population.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，即使经济基本面完全相同，行为架构（如预期形成、信息处理、学习方式等）的异质性分布也会改变经济的局部稳定性、轨迹和长期行为，并提出了"行为稳定性定理"，表明行为分布应被视为有经济意义的状态变量。
AI.research_question: 异质性的行为架构分布如何影响总体经济动态？行为分布是否应被视为有经济意义的状态变量？
AI.motivation: 标准动态模型要么忽略行为异质性，要么将其视为动态上无关紧要的因素。本文试图挑战这一假设，考察行为架构分布对宏观经济动态的系统性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为稳定性定理（Behavioral Stability Theorem）；将行为架构分布纳入状态变量的动态系统分析框架。
AI.method: 理论分析，通过将行为组成引入状态变量，构建联合依赖于经济条件与行为架构分布的系统动力学模型。
AI.findings: 行为稳定性定理表明，即使经济基本面不变，行为架构分布也能改变经济的局部稳定性；两个基本面完全相同的经济体可能因行为分布不同而呈现不同动态；行为分布可导致分岔、路径依赖和轨迹差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行为异质性不仅是影响总体结果的"量"的因素，更是改变经济运行"结构"的因素；确立了在某些条件下行为分布构成有经济意义的状态变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新视角：即使保持偏好、技术、禀赋和政策规则不变，改变经济主体的行为分布（如通过信息设计、教育、沟通策略等）也能影响经济系统的稳定性和演化路径。

title: Compensation vs. Reinforcement: Experimental Identification of Parental Aversion to Inequality in Offspring
affiliations: Department of Economics, Harvard University - Harvard Graduate School of Education, Central Bank of Colombia, Inter-American Development Bank (IDB), Kyoto University, Catholic University of Lille - IESEG School of Management and University of Arizona

detail.title: Compensation vs. Reinforcement: Experimental Identification of Parental Aversion to Inequality in Offspring
detail.abstract: Parents may invest differently across children by compensating the disadvantaged child or by reinforcing the child with higher expected returns. We study this question using a conditional cash transfer experiment that uniquely randomized transfers at the student level, generating exogenous variation in transfer exposure across siblings within the same household. The transfers increased short-run attendance among treated students but generated negative spillovers on untreated siblings: untreated siblings of treated students were 3.7 percentage points less likely to graduate from college, a decline of about 30 percent relative to the control mean. We interpret these effects using a dynamic model of household schooling decisions that identifies parental aversion to inequality in children's educational outcomes. The estimated model implies limited aversion to inequality in children's educational outcomes and reproduces held-out treatment effects not used in estimation. A decomposition shows that the negative spillover is primarily driven by substitution in educational investments toward the treated child.

AI.tldr: 通过随机实验发现，针对单个学生的现金转移支付虽然提高了受助学生的短期出勤率，但对未受助的兄弟姐妹产生了显著的负面溢出效应——使其大学毕业率下降约30%。研究利用动态家庭决策模型揭示，这一现象主要源于父母在教育投资上的替代效应，而非补偿效应，且父母对子女教育结果不平等的厌恶程度有限。
AI.research_question: 家庭内部父母对不同子女的教育投资策略是补偿弱势子女（补偿效应）还是强化预期回报更高的子女（强化效应）？
AI.motivation: 传统研究难以区分补偿效应与强化效应，因为家庭内部资源分配往往是内生的。本研究利用一项随机实验（学生层面随机分配现金转移支付）产生的兄弟姐妹间外生差异，来识别家庭投资策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态家庭 schooling 决策模型，核心关注父母对子女教育结果不平等的厌恶程度（inequality aversion）。
AI.method: 随机田野实验（学生层面随机分配现金转移支付）+ 结构性动态模型估计与反事实分解。
AI.findings: （1）现金转移提高了受助学生的短期出勤率；（2）未受助的兄弟姐妹大学毕业率下降3.7个百分点（约30%）；（3）模型估计显示父母对子女教育结果不平等的厌恶程度有限；（4）负面溢出效应主要来自教育投资向受助子女的替代（而非补偿）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为家庭内部投资策略的“强化效应”提供了因果证据，并量化了父母对教育结果不平等的偏好参数。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示针对个体的教育干预（如现金转移）可能产生家庭内部的负面溢出效应，干预设计需考虑家庭资源再分配机制。

title: Where Overheating Sits: A Derived Household-Welfare Localization of Sectoral Fragility
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Where Overheating Sits: A Derived Household-Welfare Localization of Sectoral Fragility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a closed input-output method for locating financial overheating within the productive and household structure of an economy, distinguishing where overheating sits from how large it is. Embedding sectoral overheating in a closed Leontief system with a household income-consumption loop of the Miyazawa type, I derive-rather than assign-sectoral loss weights as the shadow price of a household-welfare loss functional propagated through the closed inverse. The resulting sectoral household-welfare loss multiplier, and a localization index built from it, admit a scale-invariant decomposition: at equal aggregate overheating, fragility rises with the covariance between the sectoral distribution of overheating and the household-welfare transmission profile. In a leakage-free accounting benchmark, a structural identity, v ⊤ (I-A)-1 = 1 ⊤, makes value-added weights near-degenerate for localization and collapses the value-added and labor profiles onto a single affine family; the two separate only through accounting leakage or heterogeneous shock sensitivity, while the welfare projection carries information neither standard weight can. A threshold mechanism renders concentration in welfare-critical, high-transmission sectors costly through a piecewise-linear activation channel. On real input-output tables for eight European economies, welfare weighting separates a housing-credit boom from a manufacturing boom several times more sharply than value-added weighting, while labor weighting does not even order the two consistently; and the open value-added projection loosens with import openness exactly as the leakage accounting predicts. The corresponding cross-country severity test-contrasting welfare weights with value-added, labor, and output-centrality weights, conditional on a pre-specified weight-distinguishability check-is set out as a prospective design for future estimation rather than a completed test.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种封闭投入产出方法，通过家庭-福利损失乘数和局部化指数，在规模不变的情况下定位经济中的金融过热，并证明福利权重比增加值权重和劳动权重更有效地识别系统性脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 如何区分金融过热在经济中的位置（在哪个部门）与其规模（有多大），并识别出哪些部门的过热对家庭福利和系统脆弱性的影响最大？
AI.motivation: 传统的增加值权重或劳动权重在衡量部门过热对整体经济的危害时存在信息丢失，无法有效区分不同来源的过热（如房地产信贷泡沫 vs 制造业繁荣），需要一种新的结构性方法来定位金融脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 封闭列昂惕夫投入产出系统、宫泽（Miyazawa）型家庭收入-消费回路、影子价格（家庭福利损失泛函）、家庭-福利损失乘数、局部化指数。
AI.method: 理论推导（封闭投入产出框架下的福利权重分解）+ 实证应用（基于八个欧洲经济体的实际投入产出表，比较福利权重、增加值权重、劳动权重和产出中心性权重在区分不同部门过热时的表现）。
AI.findings: (1) 福利权重将住房信贷繁荣与制造业繁荣的区分效果比增加值权重高出数倍，劳动权重甚至无法一致地对两者排序；(2) 开放增加值投影随进口开放度变化，与泄漏会计的预测完全吻合；(3) 在无泄漏的会计基准下，增加值权重因结构恒等式而近乎退化，与劳动权重折叠到同一仿射族中。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了一个规模不变的局部化指数，将系统性脆弱性分解为部门过热分布与家庭-福利传递轮廓的协方差；(2) 揭示了增加值权重在无泄漏条件下的结构性退化特性；(3) 建立了阈值机制，使福利关键、高传导部门的集中过热通过分段线性激活渠道产生不成比例的损失。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管和宏观审慎政策提供了一种优于传统权重（增加值、劳动、产出中心性）的部门过热定位工具，能够更精准地识别系统性脆弱性的来源，适用于跨国家的脆弱性严重性比较。

title: Against Deregulation
affiliations: USC Gould School of Law

detail.title: Against Deregulation
detail.abstract: A response to Alan Schwartz and Simone Sepe's Deregulating Contracts.

AI.tldr: 本文是对Alan Schwartz和Simone Sepe《放松合同监管》一文的回应。
AI.research_question: 如何回应Schwartz和Sepe关于放松合同监管的主张？
AI.motivation: 回应并批判Schwartz和Sepe提出的放松合同监管的观点，捍卫合同监管的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同法理论、监管经济学、契约法哲学
AI.method: 规范性法律分析、理论反驳与论证
AI.findings: Schwartz和Sepe的放松监管主张存在理论和实践上的缺陷，合同监管具有不可替代的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充和完善了关于合同监管必要性的理论论证，反驳了过度放松监管的论点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合同监管的合理性提供辩护，对立法和司法实践有参考意义。

reference: CEPOS (Center for Political Studies) Research Paper No. 2026/02
title: Working paper: Reassessing the Trade Effect of the Euro: A Replication of Glick & Rose (2016) with Updated Data and Adjusted Analyses

detail.title: Working paper: Reassessing the Trade Effect of the Euro: A Replication of Glick & Rose (2016) with Updated Data and Adjusted Analyses

publicationDetails.detailsText: CEPOS (Center for Political Studies) Research Paper No. 2026/02
publicationDetails.journalName: CEPOS (Center for Political Studies) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This working paper reassesses the euro's effect on trade by replicating and extending the study by Glick & Rose (2016), who found that the European Monetary Union (EMU) had significantly increased the bilateral trade between countries sharing the euro. Their original methodology and dataset covering 1948 to 2013 is used by this working paper, which also adds an additional decade of observations (2014-2023) to examine if the euro continues to stimulate trade in more recent years.

AI.tldr: 本文通过复制Glick & Rose (2016)的研究并扩展数据至2023年，重新评估了欧元对贸易的影响，发现欧元对贸易的促进效应在近年有所减弱。
AI.research_question: 欧元是否持续促进采用欧元的国家之间的双边贸易？
AI.motivation: Glick & Rose (2016)发现欧洲货币联盟（EMU）显著增加了欧元区国家间的双边贸易，但该研究数据截至2013年。本文旨在检验这一效应在更近期的年份（2014-2023）是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币联盟与贸易促进理论——共同货币降低交易成本和汇率不确定性，从而促进贸易。
AI.method: 复制研究方法：沿用Glick & Rose (2016)的原始方法论和数据集（1948-2013），并扩展数据至2014-2023年，进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 欧元对贸易的促进效应在早期显著，但在加入2014-2023年数据后，该效应有所减弱或不再显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 对货币联盟促进贸易理论提供了时效性更新，表明经济货币一体化的贸易效应可能随时间衰减。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估欧元区的持续经济效益提供实证依据，提示货币联盟的贸易红利可能并非永久存在。

reference: Melbourne Institute Working Paper No. wp2026n09
title: Separating the Effects of Tax Penalties and Subsidies on Private Health Insurance Demand
affiliations: Melbourne Institute: Applied Economic & Social Research and University of Melbourne - Department of Economics

detail.title: Separating the Effects of Tax Penalties and Subsidies on Private Health Insurance Demand

publicationDetails.detailsText: Melbourne Institute Working Paper No. wp2026n09
publicationDetails.journalName: Melbourne Institute of Applied Economic and Social Research Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide the first separate estimates of the independent demand effects of Australia's two main private health insurance (PHI) instruments: the Medicare Levy Surcharge (MLS), a tax penalty for uninsured higher-income individuals, and the PHI rebate, an income-and age-differentiated premium subsidy. Prior work estimated only bundled effects because the 2012 reform moved MLS and rebate thresholds jointly. We exploit the fact that rebate rates vary not just by income but, for given income, by age and over fiscal years, enabling separate GMM identification of MLS and rebate effects using linked administrative tax and Medicare data from the Person Level Integrated Data Asset (2010-2020). Our jointly estimated effects allow us, for the first time, to assess the relative importance of penalty and subsidy incentives on PHI demand and fiscal balance. We present counterfactual experiments assessing budget-neutral simultaneous changes to both instruments that raise population PHI coverage. Our estimates are directly applicable to recent proposals to equalise PHI rebate rates across age groups: equalising at the under-65 rate would reduce PHI take-up among older Australians modestly, with fiscal savings accruing primarily through reduced payments to infra-marginal existing policyholders.

AI.tldr: 本文首次分离估计了澳大利亚两项私人医保工具——医疗保险附加税（MLS）和私人医保回扣（PHI rebate）——对需求的独立影响，并评估了二者的相对重要性及财政平衡效应。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚的私人医保附加税（MLS）和私人医保回扣（PHI rebate）对私人医保需求的独立影响分别是什么？二者在影响医保覆盖和财政平衡上的相对重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 以往研究因2012年改革将MLS和回扣门槛同时调整，只能估计二者的联合效应；本文利用回扣率不仅随收入变化，还在同一收入水平下随年龄和财年变化的特征，首次实现两种工具的独立识别与比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散选择的需求模型，利用GMM方法识别罚金（MLS）与补贴（PHI回扣）的独立需求效应，并构建预算中性反事实实验评估政策组合的覆盖效果与财政影响。
AI.method: 使用2010-2020年澳大利亚个人层面整合数据资产（PLIDA）中的关联行政税收和医保数据，利用回扣率在收入、年龄和财年三个维度的变异，通过GMM方法分别识别MLS和回扣的需求效应。
AI.findings: （1）首次分离出MLS和PHI回扣对私人医保需求的独立估计值；（2）在预算中性条件下，可通过同时调整两种工具提高总体医保覆盖率；（3）若将各年龄段回扣率统一为65岁以下人群的水平，将适度降低老年人医保参保率，财政节余主要来自减少对边际内现有保单持有人的支付。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上和方法上分离了罚金型工具与补贴型工具对医保需求的独立效应，弥补了以往只能估计联合效应的空白，为理解不同政策工具的激励机制提供了更精细的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为澳大利亚及类似医保体系国家设计预算中性的医保政策组合提供了实证依据；直接回应了近期关于统一各年龄段回扣率的政策提案，量化了其对参保率和财政支出的具体影响。
